title: CAMGen: A Core Change-Aware Multi-View Framework for Commit Message Generation
title_zh: CAMGen：一种面向提交信息生成的核心变更感知多视图框架

paragraphs.en: Commit messages help developers understand code changes and support software maintenance. Recent approaches use repository context to improve commit message generation (CMG) with large language models (LLMs). However, existing CMG methods provide limited support for understanding how local edits affect functionality jointly implemented by multiple code entities. This functional understanding is essential for generating commit messages that explain the main change and its impact. To address this problem, we propose CAMGen , a core c hange- a ware m ulti-view commit message gen eration framework that incorporates functional context into generation. CAMGen identifies core entities that represent the primary change intent. It then forms candidate functional units through repository-wide semantic clustering and uses those containing the core entities to construct a Functional Semantic View. This view supplies semantic context for interpreting the affected functionality. CAMGen also uses context provided by the Structural Dependency View and the Historical Exemplar View. The context from all three views is then provided to the LLM together with the code diff to guide CMG. The experimental results show that CAMGen outperforms representative CMG baselines across three programming languages. Human evaluation further shows that CAMGen generates more complete commit messages with clearer explanations of change rationale and impact. These results demonstrate the value of functional context and complementary repository information for CMG.
paragraphs.zh: 提交信息帮助开发者理解代码变更，并支持软件维护。 近期的方法利用仓库上下文来改进基于大语言模型（LLM）的提交信息生成（CMG）。 然而，现有的 CMG 方法在理解局部编辑如何影响由多个代码实体共同实现的功能方面提供的支持有限。 这种对功能的理解对于生成能够解释主要变更及其影响的提交信息至关重要。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 CAMGen，一个核心变更感知的多视角提交信息生成框架，它将功能上下文融入生成过程。 CAMGen 识别代表主要变更意图的核心实体。 随后，它通过仓库范围的语义聚类形成候选功能单元，并利用包含核心实体的单元构建功能语义视角。 该视角为解释受影响的功能提供语义上下文。 CAMGen 还利用结构依赖视角和历史示例视角所提供的上下文。 然后将来自这三个视角的上下文与代码差异一起提供给 LLM，以指导 CMG。 实验结果表明，CAMGen 在三种编程语言上均优于代表性的 CMG 基线方法。 人工评估进一步表明，CAMGen 生成的提交信息更完整，对变更原因和影响的解释更清晰。 这些结果证明了功能上下文与互补仓库信息对 CMG 的价值。

paragraphs.en: Commit messages are essential software artifacts through which developers record, understand, and communicate code changes. Prior work commonly characterizes the core content of a high-quality commit message in terms of what and why : what summarizes the primary code modifications, whereas why explains the motivation or intended objective of the change ( Tian et al., 2022 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) . Together, these two types of information allow developers to understand a commit without inspecting the entire diff or tracing its complete history, thereby supporting code review, program comprehension, collaborative development, and long-term maintenance. Commit Message Generation (CMG) aims to automatically generate natural-language commit messages from code changes. Early approaches primarily rely on predefined templates ( Buse and Weimer, 2010 ; Linares-Vásquez et al., 2015 ) or formulate CMG as a diff-to-text translation task ( Jiang et al., 2017 ; Loyola et al., 2017 ) . Subsequent research uses the code understanding and natural-language generation capabilities of pretrained models and large language models (LLMs) while incorporating repository context, such as abstract syntax trees (ASTs), call graphs, dependency graphs, repository-level code fragments, and historical diff-message pairs ( Dong et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Xiong et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2026b ) . These approaches supplement code diffs with structural, semantic, and historical information and have substantially improved the quality of generated commit messages.

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, representative CMG methods still select repository context primarily according to its direct relevance to a diff. Structural approaches expand context along dependencies near changed locations, semantic retrieval approaches return code fragments with representations similar to the diff, and history-based approaches retrieve similar diff-message pairs. These approaches treat individual code fragments, structural relations, or historical exemplars as the basic units of context construction for the code diff query, but they do not systematically identify and organize the program entities that jointly implement the affected functionality. Since the implementation of software functionality often spans multiple entities distributed across different files or modules, context captured through local structural expansion or fragment-level similarity retrieval typically covers only a subset of the entities that implement the functionality affected by the diff. Such partial context cannot fully reveal the functional units affected by a diff or the responsibilities of these units within the system. The key challenge is therefore to help LLMs understand code diffs from a functional perspective so that they can generate commit messages that accurately describe the primary change and its functional impact.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，代表性的 CMG 方法仍然主要根据仓库上下文与代码差异（diff）的直接相关性来选择仓库上下文。 结构化方法沿变更位置附近的依赖关系扩展上下文，语义检索方法返回与代码差异表示相似的代码片段，基于历史的方法检索相似的差异—提交信息对。 这些方法将单个代码片段、结构关系或历史范例视为代码差异查询的上下文构建的基本单元，但它们并未系统地识别和组织共同实现受影响功能的程序实体。 由于软件功能的实现往往跨越分布于不同文件或模块中的多个实体，通过局部结构扩展或片段级相似性检索获取的上下文通常仅覆盖实现该差异所影响功能的一部分实体。 这种不完整的上下文无法充分揭示受差异影响的功能单元及其在系统中的职责。 因此，关键挑战在于帮助大语言模型从功能视角理解代码差异，从而使其能够生成准确描述主要变更及其功能影响的提交信息。

paragraphs.en: Motivation. Consider the scenario illustrated in Figure 1 , which is drawn from commit b8a8f57 1 1 1 https://github.com/apache/hudi/commit/b8a8f57 in Apache Hudi project. The primary purpose of this commit is to add Hive-style partitioning support to the Flink writer, as expressed by the reference commit message written by the developer “ [HUDI-2094] Supports hive style partitioning for flink writer ”. The commit modifies multiple files. It introduces and propagates the Hive-style partitioning configuration, adjusts partition path parsing and reading logic, and extends the corresponding tests. Meanwhile, the diff also contains changes to configuration option names and local logic such as instantToWrite . These distributed and co-occurring edits make it difficult for the LLM to identify the primary functional intent of the commit. When the diff is supplemented with explicit structural dependency information, the LLM generates a commit message Refactor partition config options and fix instant write logic . This message identifies the changes to configuration options and write logic but still characterizes the commit as refactoring. Likewise, when the diff is supplemented with similar historical changes and their reference commit messages, the LLM generates Refactor partition configuration and fix checkpoint waiting logic in stream write . The historical context helps the model follow project-specific wording, but the generated message still focuses on local operations, such as configuration adjustments and checkpoint waiting logic, and fails to reveal the primary functional impact of adding Hive-style partitioning support. In contrast, when provided with context constructed through functional semantic clustering, the LLM generates feat(flink): Add Hive style partitioning support and rename URL encode option , which more closely reflects the primary intent expressed in the human-written commit message. This comparison between different context strategies shows that functionally cohesive repository context enables the model to associate relevant entities distributed across configuration declarations, parameter propagation, partition path processing, and test code with the same functional unit. The model can consequently understand the shared functional objective and behavioral impact of these local edits, thereby generating a commit message that accurately summarizes the primary modification and clearly explains its functional impact.

paragraphs.en: The limited ability of existing CMG methods to provide repository context that captures the functionality affected by code changes reduces the practical value of generated commit messages for developers and downstream software engineering tasks. Although a code diff records every edit in a commit, understanding the actual impact of these edits requires knowledge of the functional responsibilities of the affected entities and how the edits alter the execution logic or externally observable behavior of the corresponding functionality. Without functional context, an LLM may identify concrete operations, such as adding a condition check or adjusting a method call, but it may still fail to determine which functional unit is affected or what program behavior is changed. The resulting commit messages, therefore, tend to remain at the level of local operations or generic summaries and fail to provide complete and accurate descriptions of change impacts. Such quality limitations of commit messages force developers to inspect the code to determine the functional scope of a change, weakening the support provided by commit messages for code review, program comprehension, and software maintenance. Automated CMG, therefore, requires change-impact-aware repository context centered on functional context. Such context should connect the entities carrying the primary modification with related repository code, enabling the LLM to examine their functional responsibilities and the effects of the edits. This understanding supports commit messages that explain both the main modification and its functional and behavioral implications.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的提交信息生成（CMG）方法在提供能够反映代码变更所影响功能的仓库上下文方面能力有限，这降低了所生成的提交信息对开发者和下游软件工程任务的实际价值。 尽管代码差异（code diff）记录了提交中的每一次编辑，但要理解这些编辑的实际影响，需要了解受影响实体的功能职责，以及这些编辑如何改变相应功能的执行逻辑或外部可观察行为。 缺乏功能上下文时，大语言模型（LLM）可能识别出具体的操作，例如添加条件判断或调整方法调用，但仍可能无法确定哪个功能单元受到了影响，或程序的何种行为发生了改变。 因此，由此产生的提交信息往往停留在局部操作层面或泛泛的概述层面，无法完整而准确地描述变更影响。 提交信息的这种质量局限迫使开发者不得不检查代码以确定变更的功能范围，削弱了提交信息对代码评审、程序理解以及软件维护的支持作用。 因此，自动化提交信息生成需要以功能上下文为核心的、能感知变更影响的仓库上下文。 这种上下文应当将承载主要修改的实体与仓库中相关的代码关联起来，使大语言模型能够考察这些实体的功能职责以及编辑所带来的影响。 这种理解有助于生成既能说明主要修改、又能解释其功能与行为层面影响的提交信息。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we propose CAMGen, a core change-aware multi-view framework for commit message generation. Code modifications within a commit differ in their relevance to its primary purpose. Huang et al. ( Huang et al., 2026 ) show that prioritizing core-class changes under a fixed input budget improves several CMG methods. This finding motivates focusing functional analysis on the main modification. CAMGen first identifies its core entities: classes or functions that carry the main logic modification, feature enhancement, or defect fix in the diff. Examining these entities together with functionally related entities helps reveal which functionality is affected and how the edits change its behavior. Core entity identification thus provides the starting point for understanding the diff from a functional perspective. Based on these core entities, CAMGen constructs complementary views corresponding to three types of information considered by developers when interpreting key changes: explicit structural relations between program entities, the functional roles of the changed entities within the system, and historical examples of similar changes. Specifically, CAMGen uses the core entities to construct a Structural Dependency View ( View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} ) and a Functional Semantic View ( View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} ), while retrieving similar changes and their human-written commit messages from project history to construct a Historical Exemplar View ( View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} ). The View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} captures explicit dependencies between the core entities and other program entities. The View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} organizes repository code into candidate functional units through semantic clustering. Following ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , we adopt method clusters as candidate functional features and select those containing the core entities to provide context for interpreting the affected functionality. The View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} provides project-specific terminology and writing conventions. The View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} constitutes the central contribution of CAMGen: it helps the LLM relate the primary edits to the responsibilities of the changed entities and explain the functional impact of the code diff.

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this paper are as follows:

paragraphs.en: Approach: We propose CAMGen, a core change-aware multi-view CMG framework that constructs functional context through semantic clustering. It combines this context with structural dependencies and historical examples to guide LLMs in generating commit messages.

paragraphs.en: In recent years, CMG has attracted considerable research attention. Existing studies have progressed from early rule-based and retrieval-based approaches to neural learning-based methods, and more recently to LLM-based methods that leverage the code-understanding and natural-language-generation capabilities of LLMs. We also discuss code clustering as a methodological background for understanding the functionality jointly implemented by related code entities.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，CMG 吸引了大量研究关注。 现有研究已从早期的基于规则和基于检索的方法，发展到基于神经网络学习的方法，再到最近利用大语言模型代码理解与自然语言生成能力的基于 LLM 的方法。 我们还讨论了代码聚类作为一种方法学背景，用于理解相关代码实体共同实现的功能。

sents.en: In recent years, CMG has attracted considerable research attention.
sents.zh: 近年来，CMG 吸引了大量研究关注。

sents.en: Existing studies have progressed from early rule-based and retrieval-based approaches to neural learning-based methods, and more recently to LLM-based methods that leverage the code-understanding and natural-language-generation capabilities of LLMs.

sents.en: We also discuss code clustering as a methodological background for understanding the functionality jointly implemented by related code entities.

paragraphs.en: Early CMG approaches relied on predefined rules and templates ( Buse and Weimer, 2010 ; Linares-Vásquez et al., 2015 ; Shen et al., 2016 ) . Subsequent research has advanced along four primary directions: retrieval-based, learning-based, hybrid, and LLM-based approaches ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的CMG方法依赖于预定义的规则和模板（Buse and Weimer, 2010; Linares-Vásquez et al., 2015; Shen et al., 2016）。 后续研究沿着四个主要方向发展：基于检索的方法、基于学习的方法、混合方法和基于大语言模型的方法（Zhang et al., 2024b）。

sents.en: Early CMG approaches relied on predefined rules and templates ( Buse and Weimer, 2010 ; Linares-Vásquez et al., 2015 ; Shen et al., 2016 ) .
sents.zh: 早期的CMG方法依赖于预定义的规则和模板（Buse and Weimer, 2010; Linares-Vásquez et al., 2015; Shen et al., 2016）。

sents.en: Subsequent research has advanced along four primary directions: retrieval-based, learning-based, hybrid, and LLM-based approaches ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) .
sents.zh: 后续研究沿着四个主要方向发展：基于检索的方法、基于学习的方法、混合方法和基于大语言模型的方法（Zhang et al., 2024b）。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-based approaches. These approaches leverage commit messages associated with similar code changes. For example, NNGen ( Liu et al., 2018 ) retrieves similar diffs using cosine similarity and BLEU, while CC2Vec ( Hoang et al., 2020 ) supports retrieval through learned code-change representations. The effectiveness of these approaches depends on the relevance of the retrieved code diffs, since the retrieved message is directly reused.
paragraphs.zh: 基于检索的方法。 这些方法利用与相似代码变更相关联的提交消息。 例如，NNGen（Liu et al., 2018）使用余弦相似度和 BLEU 检索相似的 diff，而 CC2Vec（Hoang et al., 2020）通过学习到的代码变更表示来支持检索。 这些方法的有效性取决于检索到的代码 diff 的相关性，因为检索到的消息会被直接复用。

sents.en: Retrieval-based approaches.

sents.en: The effectiveness of these approaches depends on the relevance of the retrieved code diffs, since the retrieved message is directly reused.
sents.zh: 这些方法的有效性取决于检索到的代码 diff 的相关性，因为检索到的消息会被直接复用。

paragraphs.en: Learning-based approaches. These approaches learn mappings from code diffs to commit messages. Early studies formulate CMG as a neural machine translation task, exploring attention and copying mechanisms to represent changes and handle code identifiers ( Jiang et al., 2017 ; Loyola et al., 2017 ; Xu et al., 2019 ; Liu et al., 2019 ) . Specifically, FIRA ( Dong et al., 2022 ) captures edit semantics through fine-grained graphs, while CodeT5 ( Wang et al., 2021b ) and CCT5 ( Lin et al., 2023 ) provide pre-trained representations for both code and code changes, respectively. IEEF ( Chen et al., 2026 ) constructs high-quality training data and combines information extraction, information enhancement, and fine-tuning to improve the generation of what and why information. CCGen ( Huang et al., 2026 ) estimates the importance of changed classes and prioritizes core-class changes in the generation input. Its controlled comparison on multi-class commits shows that this prioritization improves several CMG methods under a fixed token budget. These results suggest that CMG should pay more attention to the core modified entities in code diffs.
paragraphs.zh: 基于学习的方法。 这些方法学习从代码差异到提交消息的映射。 早期研究将提交消息生成（CMG）表述为神经机器翻译任务，探索注意力机制和复制机制来表示变更并处理代码标识符（Jiang 等，2017；Loyola 等，2017；Xu 等，2019；Liu 等，2019）。 具体而言，FIRA（Dong 等，2022）通过细粒度图捕获编辑语义，而 CodeT5（Wang 等，2021b）和 CCT5（Lin 等，2023）分别为代码和代码变更提供预训练表示。 IEEF（Chen 等，2026）构建高质量训练数据，并结合信息抽取、信息增强和微调来改进“是什么”和“为什么”信息的生成。 CCGen（Huang 等，2026）估计被变更类的重要性，并在生成输入中优先考虑核心类的变更。 其在多类提交上的受控比较表明，在固定令牌预算下，这种优先级排序改进了多种 CMG 方法。 这些结果表明，CMG 应当更加关注代码差异中的核心被修改实体。

sents.en: Learning-based approaches.
sents.zh: 基于学习的方法。

sents.en: These approaches learn mappings from code diffs to commit messages.
sents.zh: 这些方法学习从代码差异到提交消息的映射。

sents.en: Early studies formulate CMG as a neural machine translation task, exploring attention and copying mechanisms to represent changes and handle code identifiers ( Jiang et al., 2017 ; Loyola et al., 2017 ; Xu et al., 2019 ; Liu et al., 2019 ) .
sents.zh: 早期研究将提交消息生成（CMG）表述为神经机器翻译任务，探索注意力机制和复制机制来表示变更并处理代码标识符（Jiang 等，2017；Loyola 等，2017；Xu 等，2019；Liu 等，2019）。

sents.en: Specifically, FIRA ( Dong et al., 2022 ) captures edit semantics through fine-grained graphs, while CodeT5 ( Wang et al., 2021b ) and CCT5 ( Lin et al., 2023 ) provide pre-trained representations for both code and code changes, respectively.
sents.zh: 具体而言，FIRA（Dong 等，2022）通过细粒度图捕获编辑语义，而 CodeT5（Wang 等，2021b）和 CCT5（Lin 等，2023）分别为代码和代码变更提供预训练表示。

sents.en: IEEF ( Chen et al., 2026 ) constructs high-quality training data and combines information extraction, information enhancement, and fine-tuning to improve the generation of what and why information.
sents.zh: IEEF（Chen 等，2026）构建高质量训练数据，并结合信息抽取、信息增强和微调来改进“是什么”和“为什么”信息的生成。

sents.en: CCGen ( Huang et al., 2026 ) estimates the importance of changed classes and prioritizes core-class changes in the generation input.
sents.zh: CCGen（Huang 等，2026）估计被变更类的重要性，并在生成输入中优先考虑核心类的变更。

sents.en: Its controlled comparison on multi-class commits shows that this prioritization improves several CMG methods under a fixed token budget.
sents.zh: 其在多类提交上的受控比较表明，在固定令牌预算下，这种优先级排序改进了多种 CMG 方法。

sents.en: These results suggest that CMG should pay more attention to the core modified entities in code diffs.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，CMG 应当更加关注代码差异中的核心被修改实体。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid approaches. Hybrid approaches combine retrieval and generation. ATOM ( Liu et al., 2022 ) ranks retrieved and generated messages to select the final output, whereas CoRec ( Wang et al., 2021a ) and RACE ( Shi et al., 2022 ) use similar historical commits to guide CMG. COME ( He et al., 2023 ) uses modification embeddings to distinguish added, deleted, and unchanged tokens in a code diff and employs CodeT5 to generate a candidate commit message. It also retrieves a candidate commit message from a historical commit with a similar code diff, then uses a decision algorithm to select between the generated and retrieved commit messages. These methods incorporate historical examples into the commit message generation process.
paragraphs.zh: 混合方法。 混合方法结合了检索与生成。 ATOM（Liu et al., 2022）对检索到的消息和生成的消息进行排序以选出最终输出，而 CoRec（Wang et al., 2021a）和 RACE（Shi et al., 2022）则利用相似的历史提交来指导 CMG。 COME（He et al., 2023）使用修改嵌入来区分代码差异中新增、删除和未更改的 token，并采用 CodeT5 生成候选提交消息。 它还从具有相似代码差异的历史提交中检索候选提交消息，然后使用决策算法在生成的提交消息与检索到的提交消息之间进行选择。 这些方法将历史示例融入到提交消息生成过程中。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based approaches. Recently, some studies have investigated the use of LLMs for CMG through prompting and in-context learning ( Zhang et al., 2024a ; Lopes et al., 2024 ) . Wu et al. ( Wu et al., 2025 ) examined how in-context learning configurations affect generation quality and evaluated generalization across programming languages and newly collected commits. To improve in-context example selection, Xue et al. ( Xue et al., 2024 ) proposed ERICommiter, which combines semantic and lexical retrieval to select in-context examples efficiently. CoRaCMG ( Xiong et al., 2026b ) uses hybrid retrieval of historical diff–message pairs to augment both fine-tuned models and LLM prompts. HisRag ( Lan et al., 2026 ) extends retrieval to developer and repository histories, providing historical messages as generation context. Researchers have also explored supplementing the diff with broader software context to help LLMs interpret code changes into commit messages. OMG ( Li et al., 2024 ) obtains software context through tool invocation. OMEGA ( Imani et al., 2025 ) refines summaries of changed methods and explanations of the diff to support CMG with a compact local LLM. C3Gen ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) retrieves contextual code using the repository structure. CCMG ( Li et al., 2026b ) combines project-agnostic examples with project-specific information at the project, code, and style levels, and uses two-stage prompting to generate conventional commit messages. CMO ( Li et al., 2026a ) uses an LLM to generate revised candidate commit messages based on a human-written commit message, the code diff, and additional software context. LLM-based and retrieval-based quality evaluators assess these candidate commit messages, and the highest-scoring candidate is selected for further refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 LLM 的方法。 近期，一些研究探索了通过提示和上下文学习使用 LLM 进行 CMG（Zhang et al., 2024a；Lopes et al., 2024）。Wu 等人 （Wu et al., 2025）研究了上下文学习配置如何影响生成质量，并评估了其在多种编程语言和最新收集的提交上的泛化能力。 为了改进上下文示例的选择，Xue 等人 （Xue et al., 2024）提出了 ERICommiter，该方法结合语义检索和词汇检索来高效选取上下文示例。 CoRaCMG（Xiong et al., 2026b）对历史差异—消息对进行混合检索，以增强微调模型和 LLM 提示。 HisRag（Lan et al., 2026）将检索扩展到开发者和仓库历史，提供历史消息作为生成上下文。 研究者还探索了用更广泛的软件上下文来补充差异，以帮助 LLM 将代码变更解读为提交消息。 OMG（Li et al., 2024）通过工具调用获取软件上下文。 OMEGA（Imani et al., 2025）精炼变更方法的摘要和差异的解释，以支持使用紧凑的本地 LLM 进行 CMG。 C3Gen（Xiong et al., 2025）利用仓库结构检索上下文代码。 CCMG（Li et al., 2026b）在项目、代码和风格层面将项目无关的示例与项目特定的信息相结合，并使用两阶段提示生成规范化提交消息。 CMO（Li et al., 2026a）使用 LLM 基于人工编写的提交消息、代码差异和额外的软件上下文生成修订后的候选提交消息。 基于 LLM 的和基于检索的质量评估器对这些候选提交消息进行评估，得分最高的候选消息将被选中以作进一步精炼。

paragraphs.en: Empirical studies and evaluation. Empirical studies on CMG assess the performance of existing generation methods and investigate whether evaluation metrics accurately reflect the quality of generated commit messages. Wang et al. ( Wang et al., 2025 ) evaluated seven CMG methods on the HORDA dataset, which extends CMG evaluation to commits with long code diffs or long commit messages. They found that a retrieval-based CMG method outperformed non-pretrained neural generators in within-project evaluation, while pretrained generators performed better than non-pretrained ones in CMG. Huang et al. ( Huang et al., 2024 ) evaluated learning-based CMG methods on two types of target commit messages: explicit messages that directly summarize code edits and implicit messages that describe the overall nature or intent of a change. They found that the methods performed worse when generating implicit commit messages and generalized poorly across the two commit message types. Tsvetkov et al. ( Tsvetkov et al., 2025 ) investigated whether automatic CMG evaluation metrics reflect the amount of textual editing needed to make commit messages generated by GPT-4 suitable for submission to version control. They constructed an evaluation dataset by pairing the generated commit messages with the corresponding commit messages edited by experts. Using these expert editing examples, they prompted GPT-4 Turbo to generate additional pairs of original and edited commit messages. For each pair, they used edit distance to quantify the amount of textual editing. They then examined the correlation between this amount and automatic metric scores calculated against independent reference commit messages for the same commit. The Edit Distance metric shows the strongest correlation with the amount of textual editing, whereas BLEU and METEOR scores are only weakly correlated with it. Kumar et al. ( Kumar et al., 2025 ) investigated whether LLMs could evaluate commit message quality as an alternative to text similarity metrics. Their experiments with GPT-4o, LLaMA 3.1, and Mistral Large show that LLM assessments of commit message quality align with human evaluations of the quality of the same commit messages. Zeng et al. ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) investigated the use of LLMs to evaluate whether generated commit messages accurately describe code changes and explain the rationale behind those changes.
paragraphs.zh: 实证研究与评估。 关于CMG的实证研究评估了现有生成方法的性能，并探讨评估指标是否能准确反映生成的提交信息的质量。Wang等人 （Wang et al., 2025）在HORDA数据集上评估了七种CMG方法，该数据集将CMG评估扩展到具有长代码差异或长提交信息的提交。 他们发现，在项目内评估中，基于检索的CMG方法优于非预训练的神经生成器，而在CMG中，预训练生成器的表现优于非预训练生成器。Huang等人 （Huang et al., 2024）在两类目标提交信息上评估了基于学习的CMG方法：直接总结代码编辑的显式信息，以及描述变更整体性质或意图的隐式信息。 他们发现，这些方法在生成隐式提交信息时表现较差，且在两种提交信息类型之间的泛化能力不佳。Tsvetkov等人 （Tsvetkov et al., 2025）研究了自动CMG评估指标是否能够反映使GPT-4生成的提交信息适合提交到版本控制系统所需的文本编辑量。 他们通过将生成的提交信息与专家相应修改过的提交信息配对，构建了一个评估数据集。 利用这些专家编辑示例，他们提示GPT-4 Turbo生成更多对原始和编辑后的提交信息。 对于每一对信息，他们使用编辑距离来量化文本编辑量。 然后，他们考察了这一编辑量与针对同一提交的独立参考提交信息计算出的自动指标分数之间的相关性。 编辑距离指标与文本编辑量表现出最强的相关性，而BLEU和METEOR分数与它的相关性仅为弱相关。Kumar等人 （Kumar et al., 2025）研究了LLM能否作为文本相似度指标的替代方案来评估提交信息的质量。 他们使用GPT-4o、LLaMA 3.1和Mistral Large进行的实验表明，LLM对提交信息质量的评估与人类对相同提交信息质量的评估一致。Zeng等人 （Zeng et al., 2026）研究了使用LLM评估生成的提交信息是否准确描述了代码变更并解释了这些变更背后的理由。

paragraphs.en: Code clustering organizes repository code into candidate functional units, which are groups of code entities that have related responsibilities or contribute to a common functionality across files ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Such groupings support program comprehension by bringing related entities into a shared context for examining their roles in the system and the functionality they support ( Kuhn et al., 2007 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 代码聚类将仓库代码组织成候选功能单元，即那些具有相关职责或跨文件共同贡献于同一功能的多组代码实体（Zhu et al., 2025）。 这种分组通过将相关实体纳入同一上下文，有助于理解程序，便于考察它们在系统中的角色及其所支持的功能（Kuhn et al., 2007）。

sents.en: Code clustering organizes repository code into candidate functional units, which are groups of code entities that have related responsibilities or contribute to a common functionality across files ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .

sents.en: Such groupings support program comprehension by bringing related entities into a shared context for examining their roles in the system and the functionality they support ( Kuhn et al., 2007 ) .

paragraphs.en: Kuhn et al. ( Kuhn et al., 2007 ) use latent semantic indexing to measure similarities in identifiers and comments, then cluster source artifacts into linguistic topics. Labels and visualizations of these topics reveal where related concepts occur across the existing module structure. SARIF ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) combines dependencies, topics extracted from code text, and folder structure in a weighted graph, then clusters source files to recover architectural components. These studies show how clustering exposes relationships among code elements beyond their physical organization in a repository.
paragraphs.zh: Kuhn 等人。 （Kuhn 等人，2007）使用潜在语义索引来度量标识符和注释之间的相似性，然后将源代码工件聚类为语言主题。 这些主题的标签和可视化揭示了相关概念在现有模块结构中出现的位置。 SARIF（Zhang 等人，2023）将依赖关系、从代码文本中提取的主题以及文件夹结构组合到一个加权图中，然后对源文件进行聚类以恢复架构组件。 这些研究表明，聚类如何揭示代码元素之间超越其在仓库中物理组织结构的关系。

paragraphs.en: More recent work uses clustering to generate documentation that explains repository functionality. HGEN ( Dearstyne et al., 2024 ) clusters embeddings of code summaries using multiple clustering algorithms, then generates descriptions of features or user stories from the selected clusters. It iteratively builds higher levels of documentation and establishes traceability links between the generated descriptions and the underlying artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 更近期的工作使用聚类来生成解释代码仓库功能的文档。 HGEN（Dearstyne et al., 2024）使用多种聚类算法对代码摘要的嵌入进行聚类，然后从选定的聚类中生成功能描述或用户故事。 它迭代地构建更高层级的文档，并在生成的描述与底层制品之间建立可追溯性链接。

paragraphs.en: RepoSummary ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) further organizes code around functional features through clustering at both the file and method levels. It extracts import and invocation dependencies and generates summaries of files and methods. Similarities between summary embeddings are combined with the corresponding dependencies to form weighted graphs. Using these graphs, it applies Leiden community detection first to files and then to methods within each file group, with the aim of bringing together methods with similar responsibilities or contributions to a common feature. The resulting method clusters are treated as candidate functional features. An LLM uses the method summaries in each cluster to generate feature descriptions, which are then organized into higher-level documentation. Traceability links connect the generated features to their associated methods and files, allowing developers to navigate from a functional description to its implementation.
paragraphs.zh: RepoSummary（Zhu 等人，2025）进一步通过在文件和方法两个层级上进行聚类，围绕功能特性来组织代码。 它提取导入和调用依赖关系，并生成文件和方法的摘要。 摘要嵌入之间的相似度与相应的依赖关系相结合，形成加权图。 利用这些图，它先对文件应用 Leiden 社区发现，再对每个文件组内的方法应用该算法，目的是将具有相似职责或对同一功能有贡献的方法聚集在一起。 由此得到的方法聚类被视为候选功能特性。 大语言模型（LLM）使用每个聚类中的方法摘要来生成功能描述，随后将这些描述组织成更高层级的文档。 可追溯性链接将生成的功能特性与其关联的方法和文件连接起来，使开发者能够从功能描述导航到其具体实现。

paragraphs.en: These studies establish clustering as a means of organizing code for program comprehension and functional documentation. This suggests a way to support CMG: related repository code can provide context for interpreting how code diffs affect functionality and behavior. Such context helps the LLM connect concrete modifications to the purpose and impact that an informative commit message should convey.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究确立了聚类作为一种组织代码的手段，可用于程序理解与功能文档化。 这为支持提交信息生成（CMG）提示了一种途径：仓库中的相关代码可以提供上下文，用于解释代码差异如何影响功能和行为。 这样的上下文有助于大语言模型（LLM）将具体的修改与信息丰富的提交信息所应传达的目的和影响联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Existing studies have leveraged code clustering to organize repository entities into functional groups, thereby facilitating program comprehension and documentation generation. Meanwhile, current CMG approaches incorporate historical examples and repository context to assist models in interpreting code diffs. However, these methods primarily retrieve similar historical diff-message pairs or code fragments directly related to the current diff, without explicitly linking the code diff to the broader functionality jointly implemented by the changed entities and other functionally related code entities. Such information about this broader functionality is crucial for enabling LLMs to comprehend the impact of code diffs, ultimately generating commit messages that accurately describe both the code diffs and their functional implications.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究利用代码聚类将仓库中的实体组织成功能组，从而促进程序理解与文档生成。 与此同时，当前的提交消息生成（CMG）方法结合历史样例与仓库上下文，以帮助模型解读代码差异。 然而，这些方法主要检索与当前差异直接相似的历史差异—消息对或代码片段，而未将代码差异与由变更实体及其他功能相关代码实体共同实现的更广泛功能显式关联起来。 这类关于更广泛功能的信息对于让大语言模型（LLM）理解代码差异的影响至关重要，最终生成既能准确描述代码差异又能体现其功能含义的提交消息。

paragraphs.en: Our proposed framework, CAMGen, addresses this gap by enabling LLMs to understand code diffs from a functional perspective. CAMGen first identifies the core entities carrying the main modifications. It then constructs candidate functional units through semantic clustering and extracts context from those containing the core entities. Structural dependencies around the same core entities clarify explicit code relationships, while historical diff–message examples provide references for project-specific terminologies and writing styles. CAMGen provides these contexts together with the code diff to guide the LLM in generating commit messages that capture the primary change and its functional impact.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出的框架 CAMGen 通过使大语言模型能够从功能视角理解代码差异来弥补这一空白。 CAMGen 首先识别承载主要修改的核心实体。 然后通过语义聚类构建候选功能单元，并从包含核心实体的功能单元中提取上下文。 围绕相同核心实体的结构依赖可以厘清显式的代码关系，而历史差异—提交信息示例则为项目特定的术语和写作风格提供参考。 CAMGen 将这些上下文与代码差异一起提供给大语言模型，引导其生成能够捕捉主要修改及其功能影响的提交信息。

paragraphs.en: This section presents CAMGen, a three-stage framework for generating commit messages with repository context. First, core entity identification locates the classes or functions carrying the main modification in the code diff and resolves them to repository entities. Second, CAMGen constructs the Structural Dependency View ( View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} ) and Functional Semantic View ( View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} ) around these entities, and retrieves historical diff–message examples using the current code diff to form the Historical Exemplar View ( View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} ). Finally, an LLM generates the commit message from the raw diff and the combined context.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍 CAMGen，这是一个利用仓库上下文生成提交信息的三阶段框架。 首先，核心实体识别定位代码差异中承载主要修改的类或函数，并将其解析为仓库实体。 其次，CAMGen 围绕这些实体构建结构依赖视图（ View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} ）和功能语义视图（ View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} ），并利用当前代码差异检索历史差异—信息示例，形成历史示例视图（ View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} ）。 最后，一个 LLM 根据原始差异和组合后的上下文生成提交信息。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 presents an overview of CAMGen , a three-stage framework that leverages LLMs to comprehend the intent and functional impact of code changes for the automatic generation of high-quality commit messages. More specifically, the Core entity identification stage locates the classes or functions carrying the main modification in the code diff. These entities focus the subsequent analysis on the affected functionality: their dependencies and functionally related entities help explain how the code diff changes program behavior. Then, three complementary views are constructed in the stage of Multi-view context construction to capture the change context from different perspectives: the View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} models explicit static dependencies derived from core entities, the View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} retrieves semantically related entities beyond one-hop dependencies, and the Historical Exemplar View ( View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} ) incorporates project-specific terminologies and writing styles from historical commits. Finally, the context provided by the three views is combined with the code diff and fed into the LLMs in the Message generation stage to produce commit messages that are structurally grounded, semantically informative, and stylistically consistent with project-specific conventions.
paragraphs.zh: 图2展示了CAMGen的总体概览，这是一个三阶段框架，利用大语言模型理解代码变更的意图与功能影响，从而自动生成高质量的提交信息。 具体而言，核心实体识别阶段在代码差异中定位承载主要修改的类或函数。 这些实体将后续分析聚焦于受影响的功能：它们的依赖关系以及功能相关实体有助于解释代码差异如何改变程序行为。 然后，在多视图上下文构建阶段构建三个互补的视图，从不同视角捕捉变更上下文：结构视图（View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}）建模源自核心实体的显式静态依赖，功能视图（View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}}）检索一跳依赖之外的语义相关实体，历史范例视图（View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}}）则从历史提交中融入项目特定的术语和写作风格。 最后，在信息生成阶段，将三个视图提供的上下文与代码差异相结合并输入大语言模型，生成结构上有据可依、语义上有信息量、且在风格上与项目特定约定保持一致的提交信息。

paragraphs.en: To precisely anchor the intent of a code change, we use an LLM as an intent identifier to analyze the raw diff and locate the entities carrying the primary logic changes, which are referred to as core entities (i.e., core classes or core functions) in this paper. In this stage, we design a structured prompting strategy. Specifically, the system prompt constrains the LLM to generate outputs strictly in JSON format, while the user prompt explicitly defines core entities as the primary carriers of key logic modifications, functional enhancements, or defect fixes in the code change.
paragraphs.zh: 为了精确锚定代码变更的意图，我们使用一个LLM作为意图识别器来分析原始diff，并定位承载主要逻辑变更的实体，本文将其称为核心实体（即核心类或核心函数）。 在此阶段，我们设计了一种结构化提示策略。 具体而言，系统提示约束LLM严格以JSON格式生成输出，而用户提示则明确将核心实体定义为代码变更中关键逻辑修改、功能增强或缺陷修复的主要载体。

sents.en: In this stage, we design a structured prompting strategy.

sents.en: Specifically, the system prompt constrains the LLM to generate outputs strictly in JSON format, while the user prompt explicitly defines core entities as the primary carriers of key logic modifications, functional enhancements, or defect fixes in the code change.
sents.zh: 具体而言，系统提示约束LLM严格以JSON格式生成输出，而用户提示则明确将核心实体定义为代码变更中关键逻辑修改、功能增强或缺陷修复的主要载体。

paragraphs.en: Since the entity names identified by the LLM are typically in simplified form (e.g., class names or function names), whereas entities in the repository are identified by fully qualified names, an entity name resolution step is required. We employ a suffix-based robust matching algorithm to map simplified names to concrete entity nodes in the repository. The resolved entities serve as shared inputs to both the View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} and the View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} . This design decouples intent anchoring from context construction, avoiding redundant entity identification while reducing inconsistency and computational overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 由于大语言模型识别出的实体名称通常是简化形式（例如类名或函数名），而仓库中的实体是通过全限定名标识的，因此需要进行实体名称解析步骤。 我们采用基于后缀的鲁棒匹配算法，将简化名称映射到仓库中的具体实体节点。 解析后的实体作为结构视图 \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} 和功能视图 \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 的共享输入。 这种设计将意图锚定与上下文构建解耦，在避免冗余实体识别的同时，减少了不一致性和计算开销。

sents.en: Since the entity names identified by the LLM are typically in simplified form (e.g., class names or function names), whereas entities in the repository are identified by fully qualified names, an entity name resolution step is required.
sents.zh: 由于大语言模型识别出的实体名称通常是简化形式（例如类名或函数名），而仓库中的实体是通过全限定名标识的，因此需要进行实体名称解析步骤。

sents.en: We employ a suffix-based robust matching algorithm to map simplified names to concrete entity nodes in the repository.
sents.zh: 我们采用基于后缀的鲁棒匹配算法，将简化名称映射到仓库中的具体实体节点。

sents.en: The resolved entities serve as shared inputs to both the View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} and the View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} .
sents.zh: 解析后的实体作为结构视图 \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} 和功能视图 \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 的共享输入。

sents.en: This design decouples intent anchoring from context construction, avoiding redundant entity identification while reducing inconsistency and computational overhead.
sents.zh: 这种设计将意图锚定与上下文构建解耦，在避免冗余实体识别的同时，减少了不一致性和计算开销。

paragraphs.en: This subsection presents the construction of View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} for a given code diff. Grounded in the core entities identified in Section 3.2 , this view employs static analysis to capture explicit structural dependencies within the code repository and extracts relevant contextual code with a high signal-to-noise ratio. The construction process consists of two steps: code-structure graph construction and context pruning.
paragraphs.zh: 本小节介绍如何针对给定的代码差异构建 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}。 基于 3.2 节中识别出的核心实体，该视图采用静态分析来捕获代码仓库中显式的结构依赖，并提取具有高信噪比的相关上下文代码。 构建过程包含两个步骤：代码结构图构建与上下文剪枝。

sents.en: This subsection presents the construction of View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} for a given code diff.
sents.zh: 本小节介绍如何针对给定的代码差异构建 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}。

sents.en: Grounded in the core entities identified in Section 3.2 , this view employs static analysis to capture explicit structural dependencies within the code repository and extracts relevant contextual code with a high signal-to-noise ratio.
sents.zh: 基于 3.2 节中识别出的核心实体，该视图采用静态分析来捕获代码仓库中显式的结构依赖，并提取具有高信噪比的相关上下文代码。

sents.en: The construction process consists of two steps: code-structure graph construction and context pruning.
sents.zh: 构建过程包含两个步骤：代码结构图构建与上下文剪枝。

paragraphs.en: First, we conduct static analysis over the entire code repository, taking the identified core entities as starting points, to construct a Code Structure Graph (CSG). Nodes in the CSG represent code entities at multiple granularities, including directories, files, classes, interfaces, and functions. Edges encode three types of essential semantic relationships: (i) Call edges, which capture invocation dependencies between functions; (ii) Implement/Extend edges, which model inheritance or implementation relationships between classes and interfaces; and (iii) Instantiate edges, which indicate locations where classes are instantiated. The resulting graph models the repository-level topology of explicit structural dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们以识别出的核心实体为起点，对整个代码仓库进行静态分析，以构建代码结构图（CSG）。 CSG 中的节点表示多种粒度的代码实体，包括目录、文件、类、接口和函数。 边编码了三种基本语义关系：(i) 调用边，捕获函数之间的调用依赖；(ii) 实现/继承边，建模类与接口之间的继承或实现关系；(iii) 实例化边，指示类被实例化的位置。 所得到的图对仓库级显式结构依赖的拓扑进行了建模。

sents.en: First, we conduct static analysis over the entire code repository, taking the identified core entities as starting points, to construct a Code Structure Graph (CSG).
sents.zh: 首先，我们以识别出的核心实体为起点，对整个代码仓库进行静态分析，以构建代码结构图（CSG）。

sents.en: Nodes in the CSG represent code entities at multiple granularities, including directories, files, classes, interfaces, and functions.
sents.zh: CSG 中的节点表示多种粒度的代码实体，包括目录、文件、类、接口和函数。

sents.en: Edges encode three types of essential semantic relationships: (i) Call edges, which capture invocation dependencies between functions; (ii) Implement/Extend edges, which model inheritance or implementation relationships between classes and interfaces; and (iii) Instantiate edges, which indicate locations where classes are instantiated.
sents.zh: 边编码了三种基本语义关系：(i) 调用边，捕获函数之间的调用依赖；(ii) 实现/继承边，建模类与接口之间的继承或实现关系；(iii) 实例化边，指示类被实例化的位置。

sents.en: The resulting graph models the repository-level topology of explicit structural dependencies.
sents.zh: 所得到的图对仓库级显式结构依赖的拓扑进行了建模。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate the inclusion of excessive irrelevant code, prior work has explored various strategies for selecting and pruning repository context. For example, COMMIT employs program slicing to retain statements related to code changes ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) . RepoHyper filters the graph expansion paths and reranks candidate nodes ( Phan et al., 2025 ) . HCP prunes cross-file context based on file dependencies and function-level relevance ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . In CAMGen, we design a role-aware pruning strategy. Specifically, we restrict graph traversal to one hop from each core entity and selectively retain neighboring nodes based on their semantic roles relative to the core entity.
paragraphs.zh: 为了减少引入过多无关代码，先前的工作已探索了多种选择与剪裁仓库上下文的策略。 例如，COMMIT 采用程序切片来保留与代码变更相关的语句（Jiang et al., 2024）。 RepoHyper 对图扩展路径进行过滤并对候选节点进行重排序（Phan et al., 2025）。 HCP 基于文件依赖和函数级相关性对跨文件上下文进行剪裁（Zhang et al., 2025）。 在 CAMGen 中，我们设计了一种角色感知的剪裁策略。 具体而言，我们将图遍历限制为从每个核心实体出发的一跳，并根据邻居节点相对于核心实体的语义角色选择性地保留这些节点。

sents.en: To mitigate the inclusion of excessive irrelevant code, prior work has explored various strategies for selecting and pruning repository context.
sents.zh: 为了减少引入过多无关代码，先前的工作已探索了多种选择与剪裁仓库上下文的策略。

sents.en: For example, COMMIT employs program slicing to retain statements related to code changes ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 例如，COMMIT 采用程序切片来保留与代码变更相关的语句（Jiang et al., 2024）。

sents.en: RepoHyper filters the graph expansion paths and reranks candidate nodes ( Phan et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: RepoHyper 对图扩展路径进行过滤并对候选节点进行重排序（Phan et al., 2025）。

sents.en: HCP prunes cross-file context based on file dependencies and function-level relevance ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: HCP 基于文件依赖和函数级相关性对跨文件上下文进行剪裁（Zhang et al., 2025）。

sents.en: In CAMGen, we design a role-aware pruning strategy.
sents.zh: 在 CAMGen 中，我们设计了一种角色感知的剪裁策略。

sents.en: Specifically, we restrict graph traversal to one hop from each core entity and selectively retain neighboring nodes based on their semantic roles relative to the core entity.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们将图遍历限制为从每个核心实体出发的一跳，并根据邻居节点相对于核心实体的语义角色选择性地保留这些节点。

paragraphs.en: When the core entity is a function : (i) for downstream callees, we retain only the function skeleton, including the signature, parameters, return type, and documentation string, to convey functional contracts rather than implementation details; (ii) for upstream callers, we extract the minimal logical block enclosing the call site to highlight how the change affects external invocations; and (iii) if the function overrides a method in a parent class, we extract the corresponding method skeleton from the parent class to facilitate behavioral difference analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 当核心实体是函数时：(i) 对于下游被调用者，我们仅保留函数骨架，包括签名、参数、返回类型和文档字符串，以传达功能契约而非实现细节；(ii) 对于上游调用者，我们提取包含调用点的最小逻辑块，以突出变更如何影响外部调用；(iii) 如果该函数覆盖了父类中的方法，我们从父类中提取相应的方法骨架，以便于行为差异分析。

paragraphs.en: When the core entity is a class : (i) for its parent classes or implemented interfaces, we retain the class skeleton (i.e., the set of method signatures) to expose inheritance contracts; (ii) for instantiation sites, we preserve only the minimal context snippet containing the instantiation statement; and (iii) for newly added or modified member variables, we retrieve their type definitions and extract type summaries, covering the class name and public method signatures, to clarify the semantic origin of the newly introduced state.
paragraphs.zh: 当核心实体是一个类时：（i）对于其父类或所实现的接口，我们保留类骨架（即方法签名的集合），以展示继承契约；（ii）对于实例化位置，我们仅保留包含实例化语句的最小上下文片段；（iii）对于新增或修改的成员变量，我们检索其类型定义并提取类型摘要，涵盖类名和公共方法签名，以阐明新引入状态的语义来源。

paragraphs.en: This pruning strategy preserves essential structural dependencies while substantially reducing context size, thereby providing high-density and structured inputs for subsequent CMG.
paragraphs.zh: 该剪枝策略在保留关键结构依赖的同时大幅缩减了上下文规模，从而为后续的 CMG 提供了高密度、结构化的输入。

paragraphs.en: The View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} provides repository context for interpreting the functional purpose and impact of a code diff. Following prior work ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , we treat clusters of semantically similar code entities as candidate functional units, which are groups of methods that may share related responsibilities or contribute to a common functionality. From these clusters, we select those containing the core entities identified in Section 3.2 and construct the functional context by aggregating all code entities and their source code within the selected clusters. The resulting code context is supplied together with the diff to support functional interpretation during CMG. This process consists of three steps: semantic vectorization, semantic clustering, and cluster refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 视图函数 View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 提供代码库上下文，用于解释代码差异的功能目的与影响。 沿用先前工作（Zhu et al., 2025）的做法，我们将语义相似的代码实体簇视为候选功能单元，即可能承担相关职责或共同实现某一功能的方法组。 从这些簇中，我们选取包含第 3.2 节所识别核心实体的簇，并通过聚合所选簇内的所有代码实体及其源代码来构建功能上下文。 由此得到的代码上下文与代码差异一同提供，以支持提交消息生成（CMG）过程中的功能解释。 该过程包括三个步骤：语义向量化、语义聚类和簇精炼。

sents.en: The View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} provides repository context for interpreting the functional purpose and impact of a code diff.
sents.zh: 视图函数 View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 提供代码库上下文，用于解释代码差异的功能目的与影响。

sents.en: Following prior work ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , we treat clusters of semantically similar code entities as candidate functional units, which are groups of methods that may share related responsibilities or contribute to a common functionality.
sents.zh: 沿用先前工作（Zhu et al., 2025）的做法，我们将语义相似的代码实体簇视为候选功能单元，即可能承担相关职责或共同实现某一功能的方法组。

sents.en: From these clusters, we select those containing the core entities identified in Section 3.2 and construct the functional context by aggregating all code entities and their source code within the selected clusters.
sents.zh: 从这些簇中，我们选取包含第 3.2 节所识别核心实体的簇，并通过聚合所选簇内的所有代码实体及其源代码来构建功能上下文。

sents.en: The resulting code context is supplied together with the diff to support functional interpretation during CMG.
sents.zh: 由此得到的代码上下文与代码差异一同提供，以支持提交消息生成（CMG）过程中的功能解释。

sents.en: This process consists of three steps: semantic vectorization, semantic clustering, and cluster refinement.
sents.zh: 该过程包括三个步骤：语义向量化、语义聚类和簇精炼。

paragraphs.en: Semantic vectorization provides the representations used to group repository entities into candidate functional units. We use CodeBERT ( Feng et al., 2020 ) , a pre-trained code language model, to encode the entities. Before encoding, we prepare the input code to account for the 512-token input limit of CodeBERT. For class entities exceeding this threshold, we apply Tree-sitter-based code skeleton extraction ( Tree-sitter Contributors, ) , preserving the class declaration, method signatures, and complete field definitions while removing method implementation bodies. For class entities within the token budget and all non-class entities (e.g., functions), we retain the original code. This preparation preserves structural and semantic cues from large classes while reducing the amount of code subject to truncation. We encode each prepared snippet into a 768-dimensional vector and normalize it to unit length. In high-dimensional spaces, pairwise distances tend to be less distinguishable, reducing the contrast between near and far neighbors ( Beyer et al., 1999 ) . We therefore project the normalized vectors into a 20-dimensional space using UMAP ( McInnes et al., 2018 ) , which seeks to preserve local neighborhood structure. These projected representations serve as input to the clustering step.
paragraphs.zh: 语义向量化提供了用于将仓库实体分组成候选功能单元的表示。 我们使用 CodeBERT（Feng et al., 2020），一个预训练的代码语言模型，来对实体进行编码。 在编码之前，我们准备输入代码以适应 CodeBERT 的 512 词元输入限制。 对于超过该阈值的类实体，我们应用基于 Tree-sitter 的代码骨架提取（Tree-sitter Contributors,），在移除方法实现体的同时保留类声明、方法签名和完整的字段定义。 对于在词元预算内的类实体以及所有非类实体（例如函数），我们保留原始代码。 这种准备方式在减少被截断代码数量的同时，保留了大型类的结构和语义线索。 我们将每个准备好的代码片段编码为一个 768 维向量，并将其归一化为单位长度。 在高维空间中，成对距离往往难以区分，降低了近邻与远邻之间的对比度（Beyer et al., 1999）。 因此，我们使用 UMAP（McInnes et al., 2018）将归一化后的向量投影到一个 20 维空间中，该投影旨在保留局部邻域结构。 这些投影后的表示作为聚类步骤的输入。

sents.zh: 语义向量化提供了用于将仓库实体分组成候选功能单元的表示。

sents.en: We use CodeBERT ( Feng et al., 2020 ) , a pre-trained code language model, to encode the entities.
sents.zh: 我们使用 CodeBERT（Feng et al., 2020），一个预训练的代码语言模型，来对实体进行编码。

sents.en: Before encoding, we prepare the input code to account for the 512-token input limit of CodeBERT.
sents.zh: 在编码之前，我们准备输入代码以适应 CodeBERT 的 512 词元输入限制。

sents.en: For class entities exceeding this threshold, we apply Tree-sitter-based code skeleton extraction ( Tree-sitter Contributors, ) , preserving the class declaration, method signatures, and complete field definitions while removing method implementation bodies.
sents.zh: 对于超过该阈值的类实体，我们应用基于 Tree-sitter 的代码骨架提取（Tree-sitter Contributors,），在移除方法实现体的同时保留类声明、方法签名和完整的字段定义。

sents.en: For class entities within the token budget and all non-class entities (e.g., functions), we retain the original code.
sents.zh: 对于在词元预算内的类实体以及所有非类实体（例如函数），我们保留原始代码。

sents.en: This preparation preserves structural and semantic cues from large classes while reducing the amount of code subject to truncation.
sents.zh: 这种准备方式在减少被截断代码数量的同时，保留了大型类的结构和语义线索。

sents.en: We encode each prepared snippet into a 768-dimensional vector and normalize it to unit length.
sents.zh: 我们将每个准备好的代码片段编码为一个 768 维向量，并将其归一化为单位长度。

sents.en: In high-dimensional spaces, pairwise distances tend to be less distinguishable, reducing the contrast between near and far neighbors ( Beyer et al., 1999 ) .
sents.zh: 在高维空间中，成对距离往往难以区分，降低了近邻与远邻之间的对比度（Beyer et al., 1999）。

sents.en: We therefore project the normalized vectors into a 20-dimensional space using UMAP ( McInnes et al., 2018 ) , which seeks to preserve local neighborhood structure.
sents.zh: 因此，我们使用 UMAP（McInnes et al., 2018）将归一化后的向量投影到一个 20 维空间中，该投影旨在保留局部邻域结构。

sents.en: These projected representations serve as input to the clustering step.
sents.zh: 这些投影后的表示作为聚类步骤的输入。

paragraphs.en: We apply HDBSCAN ( Campello et al., 2015 ) to the projected representations to form candidate functional units. The resulting clusters range from a few to dozens of entities, while some entities may be labeled as noise. To preserve all core entities during context construction, we reassign any core entity labeled as noise to the nearest non-noise cluster. We then retain clusters containing at least one mapped core entity, focusing the selected context on the primary change. Formally, let 𝒞 = { C 1 , C 2 , … , C m } \mathcal{C}=\{C_{1},C_{2},\ldots,C_{m}\} denote the clusters after this reassignment and ℰ m ​ a ​ p ​ p ​ e ​ d \mathcal{E}_{mapped} denote the set of mapped core entities. The selected candidate functional units are defined as:

sents.zh: 我们将 HDBSCAN（Campello et al., 2015）应用于投影后的表示，以形成候选功能单元。

sents.en: To preserve all core entities during context construction, we reassign any core entity labeled as noise to the nearest non-noise cluster.

sents.zh: 然后，我们保留至少包含一个已映射核心实体的聚类，使所选上下文聚焦于主要变更。

paragraphs.en: The goal of this step is to keep each selected cluster compact enough for CMG while preserving the core entities and their most relevant functional neighbors. Although HDBSCAN produces semantically cohesive groups, some clusters may still contain too many entities to serve as concise context. To this end, we refine each cluster in 𝒞 c ​ o ​ r ​ e \mathcal{C}_{core} by imposing a core-centric cluster-size limit M M . Specifically, for any cluster containing more than M M entities, we retain all core entities and fill the remaining slots with non-core entities closest to the core centroid in semantic space. Clusters containing at most M M entities are kept unchanged. We set M = 10 M{=}10 by default as a practical trade-off between contextual coverage and prompt budget. Each retained entity contributes a non-trivial amount of source code, and the prompt must also reserve space for the code diff and task instructions. A larger M M increases token cost and semantic noise, whereas a smaller M M may omit useful functional neighbors of the core entities. This refinement produces compact functional context centered on the core entities for subsequent CMG.
paragraphs.zh: 本步骤的目标是让每个选定的簇对CMG而言足够紧凑，同时保留核心实体及其最相关的功能邻居。 尽管HDBSCAN能够生成语义上内聚的分组，但某些簇可能仍包含过多实体，无法作为简洁的上下文。 为此，我们通过施加以核心为中心的簇大小上限 M M 来对 𝒞 c ​ o ​ r ​ e \mathcal{C}_{core} 中的每个簇进行细化。 具体而言，对于包含超过 M M 个实体的簇，我们保留全部核心实体，并用在语义空间中距核心质心最近的非核心实体填充剩余名额。 包含至多 M M 个实体的簇保持不变。 默认设 M = 10 M{=}10，作为上下文覆盖范围与提示词预算之间的实际折中。 每个保留的实体都贡献相当数量的源代码，且提示词还必须为代码差异和任务说明预留空间。 较大的 M M 会增加令牌开销和语义噪声，而较小的 M M 可能遗漏核心实体的有用功能邻居。 这种细化产生了以核心实体为中心的紧凑功能上下文，供后续CMG使用。

sents.en: The goal of this step is to keep each selected cluster compact enough for CMG while preserving the core entities and their most relevant functional neighbors.
sents.zh: 本步骤的目标是让每个选定的簇对CMG而言足够紧凑，同时保留核心实体及其最相关的功能邻居。

sents.en: Although HDBSCAN produces semantically cohesive groups, some clusters may still contain too many entities to serve as concise context.
sents.zh: 尽管HDBSCAN能够生成语义上内聚的分组，但某些簇可能仍包含过多实体，无法作为简洁的上下文。

sents.en: To this end, we refine each cluster in 𝒞 c ​ o ​ r ​ e \mathcal{C}_{core} by imposing a core-centric cluster-size limit M M .
sents.zh: 为此，我们通过施加以核心为中心的簇大小上限 M M 来对 𝒞 c ​ o ​ r ​ e \mathcal{C}_{core} 中的每个簇进行细化。

sents.en: Specifically, for any cluster containing more than M M entities, we retain all core entities and fill the remaining slots with non-core entities closest to the core centroid in semantic space.
sents.zh: 具体而言，对于包含超过 M M 个实体的簇，我们保留全部核心实体，并用在语义空间中距核心质心最近的非核心实体填充剩余名额。

sents.en: Clusters containing at most M M entities are kept unchanged.
sents.zh: 包含至多 M M 个实体的簇保持不变。

sents.en: We set M = 10 M{=}10 by default as a practical trade-off between contextual coverage and prompt budget.
sents.zh: 默认设 M = 10 M{=}10，作为上下文覆盖范围与提示词预算之间的实际折中。

sents.en: Each retained entity contributes a non-trivial amount of source code, and the prompt must also reserve space for the code diff and task instructions.
sents.zh: 每个保留的实体都贡献相当数量的源代码，且提示词还必须为代码差异和任务说明预留空间。

sents.en: A larger M M increases token cost and semantic noise, whereas a smaller M M may omit useful functional neighbors of the core entities.
sents.zh: 较大的 M M 会增加令牌开销和语义噪声，而较小的 M M 可能遗漏核心实体的有用功能邻居。

sents.en: This refinement produces compact functional context centered on the core entities for subsequent CMG.
sents.zh: 这种细化产生了以核心实体为中心的紧凑功能上下文，供后续CMG使用。

paragraphs.en: While View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} and View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} characterize the structural and semantic context of code changes from a static perspective, they are insufficient to capture project-specific terminologies and writing styles of commit messages. In practice, semantically similar changes may be described differently across projects. For example, fixing a null pointer exception may be phrased as “fix NPE in X” in one project, whereas another may prefer “prevent null dereference in Y”. To address this gap, we introduce the Historical Exemplar View ( View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} ), which injects project-specific terminologies and writing styles by retrieving similar change instances from the project’s commit history.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} 和 View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 从静态视角刻画了代码变更的结构上下文和语义上下文，但它们不足以捕捉项目特定的术语和提交信息的写作风格。 在实践中，语义相似的变更在不同项目中可能有不同的描述方式。 例如，修复空指针异常在一个项目中可能被表述为“fix NPE in X”，而另一个项目可能更倾向于使用“prevent null dereference in Y”。 为了弥补这一不足，我们引入了历史范例视图（ View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} ），它通过从项目的提交历史中检索相似的变更实例，注入项目特定的术语和写作风格。

sents.en: While View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} and View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} characterize the structural and semantic context of code changes from a static perspective, they are insufficient to capture project-specific terminologies and writing styles of commit messages.
sents.zh: 虽然 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} 和 View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 从静态视角刻画了代码变更的结构上下文和语义上下文，但它们不足以捕捉项目特定的术语和提交信息的写作风格。

sents.en: In practice, semantically similar changes may be described differently across projects.
sents.zh: 在实践中，语义相似的变更在不同项目中可能有不同的描述方式。

sents.en: For example, fixing a null pointer exception may be phrased as “fix NPE in X” in one project, whereas another may prefer “prevent null dereference in Y”.
sents.zh: 例如，修复空指针异常在一个项目中可能被表述为“fix NPE in X”，而另一个项目可能更倾向于使用“prevent null dereference in Y”。

sents.en: To address this gap, we introduce the Historical Exemplar View ( View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} ), which injects project-specific terminologies and writing styles by retrieving similar change instances from the project’s commit history.
sents.zh: 为了弥补这一不足，我们引入了历史范例视图（ View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} ），它通过从项目的提交历史中检索相似的变更实例，注入项目特定的术语和写作风格。

paragraphs.en: This view is constructed via semantic vector retrieval to efficiently identify relevant historical exemplars. Specifically, we treat the diff of the current commit as a query and encode it into a 768-dimensional dense vector using a code-specific embedding model trained by Jina AI ( jina-embeddings-v2-base-code ) ( Jina AI, 2024 ) . Pre-trained on large-scale, multi-language code corpora, the model can capture the semantic essence of code changes (such as functional intent and modification patterns), rather than relying solely on surface-level textual or structural features.
paragraphs.zh: 该视图通过语义向量检索构建，以高效识别相关的历史示例。 具体而言，我们将当前提交的 diff 作为查询，并使用由 Jina AI 训练的面向代码的嵌入模型（jina-embeddings-v2-base-code）（Jina AI, 2024）将其编码为 768 维的稠密向量。 该模型在大规模多语言代码语料库上进行了预训练，能够捕捉代码变更的语义本质（例如功能意图和修改模式），而不仅仅依赖表层的文本或结构特征。

sents.en: This view is constructed via semantic vector retrieval to efficiently identify relevant historical exemplars.
sents.zh: 该视图通过语义向量检索构建，以高效识别相关的历史示例。

sents.en: Specifically, we treat the diff of the current commit as a query and encode it into a 768-dimensional dense vector using a code-specific embedding model trained by Jina AI ( jina-embeddings-v2-base-code ) ( Jina AI, 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们将当前提交的 diff 作为查询，并使用由 Jina AI 训练的面向代码的嵌入模型（jina-embeddings-v2-base-code）（Jina AI, 2024）将其编码为 768 维的稠密向量。

sents.en: Pre-trained on large-scale, multi-language code corpora, the model can capture the semantic essence of code changes (such as functional intent and modification patterns), rather than relying solely on surface-level textual or structural features.
sents.zh: 该模型在大规模多语言代码语料库上进行了预训练，能够捕捉代码变更的语义本质（例如功能意图和修改模式），而不仅仅依赖表层的文本或结构特征。

paragraphs.en: To enable efficient retrieval, we precompute embeddings for the diffs in the retrieval corpus and apply L2 normalization, so that similarity computation can be reduced to efficient dot-product operations. For each target commit, we restrict the retrieval candidates to commits from the same repository whose timestamps are strictly earlier than that of the current commit. We then compute cosine similarity between the query vector and the vectors of these eligible commits, select the most similar candidates, and extract their corresponding diffs and developer-written commit messages as historical diff-message pairs (exemplars). These exemplars reflect how developers describe semantically similar changes in practice, thereby providing direct references to project-specific terminologies and writing styles for CMG.
paragraphs.zh: 为实现高效检索，我们对检索语料库中的差异（diffs）预先计算嵌入并进行 L2 归一化，从而将相似度计算简化为高效的点积运算。 对于每个目标提交，我们将检索候选限制在同一仓库中时间戳严格早于当前提交的那些提交。 然后，我们计算查询向量与这些合格提交的向量之间的余弦相似度，选出最相似的候选，并提取其对应的差异与开发者撰写的提交信息，作为历史差异—信息对（范例）。 这些范例反映了开发者在实际中如何描述语义相似的变更，从而为提交信息生成（CMG）提供了关于项目特定术语和写作风格的直接参考。

sents.en: To enable efficient retrieval, we precompute embeddings for the diffs in the retrieval corpus and apply L2 normalization, so that similarity computation can be reduced to efficient dot-product operations.
sents.zh: 为实现高效检索，我们对检索语料库中的差异（diffs）预先计算嵌入并进行 L2 归一化，从而将相似度计算简化为高效的点积运算。

sents.en: For each target commit, we restrict the retrieval candidates to commits from the same repository whose timestamps are strictly earlier than that of the current commit.
sents.zh: 对于每个目标提交，我们将检索候选限制在同一仓库中时间戳严格早于当前提交的那些提交。

sents.en: We then compute cosine similarity between the query vector and the vectors of these eligible commits, select the most similar candidates, and extract their corresponding diffs and developer-written commit messages as historical diff-message pairs (exemplars).
sents.zh: 然后，我们计算查询向量与这些合格提交的向量之间的余弦相似度，选出最相似的候选，并提取其对应的差异与开发者撰写的提交信息，作为历史差异—信息对（范例）。

sents.en: These exemplars reflect how developers describe semantically similar changes in practice, thereby providing direct references to project-specific terminologies and writing styles for CMG.
sents.zh: 这些范例反映了开发者在实际中如何描述语义相似的变更，从而为提交信息生成（CMG）提供了关于项目特定术语和写作风格的直接参考。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the selected exemplars are integrated as supplementary context and jointly fed into an LLM in the Message generation stage with the outputs from the other two views. The key value of this view lies in its ability to convey not only historical code diff-message pairs but also project-specific terminologies and writing styles. These historical examples guide the LLM in describing the current change using project-specific terminology and writing conventions.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，在 Message 生成阶段，被选中的示例将作为补充上下文，与来自另外两个视图的输出一起共同输入大语言模型。 该视图的关键价值在于，它不仅能传递历史代码差异与提交信息的配对，还能传递项目专用的术语和写作风格。 这些历史示例引导大语言模型使用项目专用的术语和写作惯例来描述当前的变更。

sents.en: Finally, the selected exemplars are integrated as supplementary context and jointly fed into an LLM in the Message generation stage with the outputs from the other two views.
sents.zh: 最后，在 Message 生成阶段，被选中的示例将作为补充上下文，与来自另外两个视图的输出一起共同输入大语言模型。

sents.en: The key value of this view lies in its ability to convey not only historical code diff-message pairs but also project-specific terminologies and writing styles.
sents.zh: 该视图的关键价值在于，它不仅能传递历史代码差异与提交信息的配对，还能传递项目专用的术语和写作风格。

sents.en: These historical examples guide the LLM in describing the current change using project-specific terminology and writing conventions.
sents.zh: 这些历史示例引导大语言模型使用项目专用的术语和写作惯例来描述当前的变更。

paragraphs.en: In this stage, CAMGen combines the raw code diff with the context from View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} , View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} , and View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} into a unified prompt for an LLM. The structural context captures structural dependencies around the core entities of the code diff. The functional context complements these dependencies with code from the selected candidate functional units, helping the LLM interpret the responsibilities of the changed entities and the behavioral impact of the diff. Historical diff–message pairs provide examples of project-specific terminologies and writing conventions. The LLM then uses the code diff and the multi-view context to generate the corresponding commit message.
paragraphs.zh: 在该阶段，CAMGen 将原始代码差异与来自 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}、View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 和 View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 的上下文合并为一个统一的提示词，提供给大语言模型（LLM）。 结构性上下文捕捉代码差异核心实体周围的结构依赖关系。 功能性上下文通过来自所选候选功能单元的代码补充这些依赖关系，帮助大语言模型理解被更改实体的职责以及差异对行为的影响。 历史差异—提交消息对提供了项目特定术语和写作规范的示例。 随后，大语言模型利用代码差异和多视图上下文生成相应的提交消息。

sents.zh: 在该阶段，CAMGen 将原始代码差异与来自 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}、View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 和 View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 的上下文合并为一个统一的提示词，提供给大语言模型（LLM）。

sents.zh: 结构性上下文捕捉代码差异核心实体周围的结构依赖关系。

sents.en: The functional context complements these dependencies with code from the selected candidate functional units, helping the LLM interpret the responsibilities of the changed entities and the behavioral impact of the diff.
sents.zh: 功能性上下文通过来自所选候选功能单元的代码补充这些依赖关系，帮助大语言模型理解被更改实体的职责以及差异对行为的影响。

sents.en: Historical diff–message pairs provide examples of project-specific terminologies and writing conventions.
sents.zh: 历史差异—提交消息对提供了项目特定术语和写作规范的示例。

sents.en: The LLM then uses the code diff and the multi-view context to generate the corresponding commit message.
sents.zh: 随后，大语言模型利用代码差异和多视图上下文生成相应的提交消息。

paragraphs.en: The main objective of this study is to systematically evaluate the effectiveness of CAMGen for CMG by answering four research questions (RQs). More specifically, RQ1 evaluates the overall performance of the CAMGen framework by comparing it with representative CMG baselines using automatic evaluation metrics. Based on these results, RQ2 investigates the specific components that contribute to its performance gains. RQ3 further assesses the quality of the generated commit messages through human evaluation from the developers’ perspective. Finally, RQ4 conducts a case study of representative CAMGen outputs with low automatic metric scores to identify the causes of these low automatic evaluation scores.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的主要目标是通过回答四个研究问题（RQ），系统性地评估 CAMGen 在提交消息生成（CMG）任务上的有效性。 具体而言，RQ1 通过使用自动评估指标将 CAMGen 框架与具有代表性的 CMG 基线方法进行比较，评估其整体性能。 基于这些结果，RQ2 研究为其性能提升做出贡献的具体组件。 RQ3 进一步从开发者的视角出发，通过人工评估来评估所生成提交消息的质量。 最后，RQ4 对自动指标得分较低的代表性 CAMGen 输出进行案例研究，以找出这些自动评估得分较低的原因。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Overall Effectiveness: How does CAMGen perform compared to representative SOTA CMG approaches?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：整体有效性：与具有代表性的SOTA CMG方法相比，CAMGen的表现如何？

paragraphs.en: This RQ aims to investigate the overall effectiveness of our CAMGen framework by evaluating the quality of generated commit messages with automatic metrics. We compare CAMGen with five representative SOTA CMG approaches, i.e., NNGen, CoRec, RACE, COME, and CCT5. To examine the influence of the underlying LLM, we employ DeepSeek-V3.2, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and GPT-5.4 as the backbone generators in independent experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究问题旨在通过使用自动指标评估生成提交消息的质量，来考察我们 CAMGen 框架的整体有效性。 我们将 CAMGen 与五种具有代表性的 SOTA CMG 方法进行比较，即 NNGen、CoRec、RACE、COME 和 CCT5。 为考察底层 LLM 的影响，我们在独立实验中采用 DeepSeek-V3.2、DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 GPT-5.4 作为骨干生成器。

paragraphs.en: RQ2: Ablation Study: How do the individual design components of CAMGen contribute to its performance in CMG? To systematically evaluate the contribution of each design component within the CAMGen framework, we decompose this RQ into two sub-RQs:
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：消融实验：CAMGen 的各个设计组件对其在 CMG 中的性能有何贡献？ 为了系统地评估 CAMGen 框架中每个设计组件的贡献，我们将该研究问题分解为两个子问题：

sents.en: RQ2: Ablation Study: How do the individual design components of CAMGen contribute to its performance in CMG?
sents.zh: RQ2：消融实验：CAMGen 的各个设计组件对其在 CMG 中的性能有何贡献？

sents.en: To systematically evaluate the contribution of each design component within the CAMGen framework, we decompose this RQ into two sub-RQs:
sents.zh: 为了系统地评估 CAMGen 框架中每个设计组件的贡献，我们将该研究问题分解为两个子问题：

paragraphs.en: RQ2.1: Core Entity Identification: Can CAMGen reliably identify and anchor core entities to serve as the foundational input for change-aware context construction?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2.1：核心实体识别：CAMGen 能否可靠地识别并锚定核心实体，以作为构建变更感知上下文的基础输入？

paragraphs.en: RQ2.2: View Contribution Analysis: What are the individual and combined contributions of View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} , View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} , and View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} to the overall performance of CAMGen?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2.2：视图贡献分析：View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}、View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 和 View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 对 CAMGen 整体性能的单独贡献和综合贡献分别是什么？

paragraphs.en: More specifically, RQ2.1 is designed to examine whether the core entities identified by an LLM provide reliable anchors for subsequent context construction. RQ2.2 progressively incorporates the contexts provided by View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} , View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} , and View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} on the same samples. Using a comparison of the diff-only, single-view, two-view, and three-view context configurations, this ablation study intends to evaluate the individual contributions and combined complementarity of each view. The answers to these two sub-RQs would help pinpoint the sources of CAMGen’s performance gains and provide empirical evidence validating the integration of the change-aware context from three perspectives.
paragraphs.zh: 更具体地说，RQ2.1 旨在考察 LLM 识别出的核心实体能否为后续上下文构建提供可靠的锚点。 RQ2.2 在相同的样本上逐步引入 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}、View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 和 View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 所提供的上下文。 通过比较 diff-only、单视图、双视图和三视图的上下文配置，本消融研究旨在评估各视图的独立贡献及其组合的互补性。 这两个子研究问题的答案有助于精确定位 CAMGen 性能提升的来源，并为从三个视角融合变更感知上下文的有效性提供实证依据。

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Human Evaluation: How does CAMGen perform from the developers’ perspective? RQ3 is designed to assess whether the improvements captured by automatic metrics correspond to the improvement in the perceived quality of the generated commit messages. Automatic metrics primarily measure the lexical, sequential, or semantic similarity between a generated message and a reference commit message, and may fail to fully reflect whether the message accurately captures the core changes, explains its underlying rationale, or describes its corresponding functional impact. Building on these limitations, RQ3 empirically investigates the practical quality of commit messages generated by CAMGen from the developers’ perspective, with dedicated attention to Comprehensiveness , Rationality , Change Impact Explanation , Conciseness , and Expressiveness . Answering this RQ will not only help evaluate the practical value of CAMGen for developers, but also verify whether the performance gains observed in automatic metrics align with improvements in perceived commit message quality.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：人工评估：从开发者视角来看，CAMGen 的表现如何？ RQ3 旨在评估自动指标所捕捉到的改进是否与生成的提交信息在感知质量上的提升相对应。 自动指标主要衡量生成信息与参考提交信息之间的词汇、序列或语义相似性，可能无法充分反映该信息是否准确捕捉了核心变更、解释了其背后的原理，或描述了相应的功能影响。 基于这些局限性，RQ3 从开发者视角实证考察 CAMGen 生成的提交信息的实际质量，并特别关注全面性、合理性、变更影响说明、简洁性和表达力。 回答这一研究问题不仅有助于评估 CAMGen 对开发者的实际价值，还能验证自动指标中观察到的性能提升是否与提交信息感知质量的改进相一致。

paragraphs.en: RQ4: Qualitative Case Analysis: What are the underlying causes of CAMGen’s underperformance under automatic metrics? This RQ aims to conduct a qualitative analysis of CAMGen’s underperforming cases. Specifically, we sample instances from RQ1 where generated commit messages of CAMGen receive low scores on automatic metrics, and analyze these cases to identify and summarize the categories of poor performance. Answering this RQ would shed light on the factors that limit the performance of CAMGen and offer guidance for further improvements to CMG.
paragraphs.zh: RQ4：定性案例分析：CAMGen 在自动指标下表现不佳的根本原因是什么？ 该研究问题旨在对 CAMGen 表现不佳的案例进行定性分析。 具体而言，我们从 RQ1 中抽取 CAMGen 生成的提交信息在自动指标上得分较低的实例，并分析这些案例，以识别和归纳表现不佳的类别。 回答该研究问题有助于揭示限制 CAMGen 性能的因素，并为 CMG 的进一步改进提供指导。

paragraphs.en: All experiments in this study are conducted on ApacheCM ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) , a dataset constructed from open-source projects maintained by the Apache Software Foundation. Each commit record contains the code diff, commit message, repository identifier, commit hash, author, commit date, modified files, and additional metadata. Unlike datasets that retain only <diff, message> pairs, ApacheCM preserves this richer metadata, enabling data partitioning based on programming language, repository-level analysis, and downstream context retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的所有实验均在 ApacheCM（Xiong et al., 2025）上进行，这是一个由 Apache 软件基金会维护的开源项目构建而成的数据集。 每条提交记录包含代码差异（code diff）、提交信息、仓库标识符、提交哈希、作者、提交日期、修改的文件以及其他元数据。 与仅保留 <diff, message> 对的数据集不同，ApacheCM 保留了更丰富的元数据，从而支持基于编程语言的数据划分、仓库级分析以及下游上下文检索。

paragraphs.en: To address RQ1, we construct evaluation subsets for Java, C++, and Python to assess the across-language performance of CAMGen. For each programming language, we randomly sampled 5,000 commits from ApacheCM to construct an initial candidate set. This common sampling budget keeps the candidate sets comparable in size while allowing for exclusions during preprocessing. We then exclude commits whose corresponding repository snapshots cannot be recovered or for which the static analysis required for context construction cannot be completed. After this screening, the final evaluation set contains 2,498 C++ commits, 2,469 Java commits, and 2,555 Python commits, totaling 7,522 commits.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答RQ1，我们为Java、C++和Python构建了评估子集，以评估CAMGen的跨语言性能。 对于每种编程语言，我们从ApacheCM中随机抽取了5,000个提交，构建初始候选集。 这一共同的抽样规模使各候选集在规模上具有可比性，同时允许在预处理过程中进行排除。 随后，我们排除那些对应的仓库快照无法恢复、或构建上下文所需的静态分析无法完成的提交。 经过筛选后，最终评估集包含2,498个C++提交、2,469个Java提交和2,555个Python提交，总计7,522个提交。

paragraphs.en: To investigate the effectiveness of LLM-based core-entity identification in CAMGen, we randomly sample 100 commits from ApacheCM for RQ2.1. We manually annotate program entities, including classes, functions, and interfaces, and treat these annotations as the gold labels. DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Pro then identify core entities in the same commits.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究 CAMGen 中基于大语言模型的核心实体识别的有效性，我们从 ApacheCM 中随机抽取 100 个提交用于 RQ2.1。 我们人工标注程序实体，包括类、函数和接口，并将这些标注作为金标准标签。 然后 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在相同的提交中识别核心实体。

paragraphs.en: To analyze individual contributions, combined effects, and complementarity of the three views, we randomly sample 1,000 commits from the three language datasets used in RQ1 for the RQ2.2 ablation study. We fix DeepSeek-V3.2 as the generator and compare eight context configurations: Diff only, three single-view configurations, three two-view configurations, and CAMGen (Full). All configurations take the raw code diff as input. The diff-only configuration includes no additional repository context. The three single-view configurations add context provided by View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} , View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} , and View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} , respectively. The two-view configurations combine context provided by two views, whereas CAMGen (Full) uses context from all three views.
paragraphs.zh: 为了分析三种视图的单独贡献、组合效果与互补性，我们从 RQ1 中使用的三个语言数据集中随机抽取 1,000 个提交，用于 RQ2.2 的消融实验。 我们固定 DeepSeek-V3.2 作为生成器，并比较八种上下文配置：仅 Diff、三种单视图配置、三种双视图配置以及 CAMGen (Full)。 所有配置均以原始代码 diff 作为输入。 仅 Diff 配置不包含任何额外的仓库上下文。 三种单视图配置分别加入由 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}、View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 和 View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 提供的上下文。 双视图配置组合两个视图提供的上下文，而 CAMGen (Full) 则使用来自全部三个视图的上下文。

paragraphs.en: For human evaluation in RQ3, we sample 50 commits from the RQ2.2 ablation subset and reuse the corresponding DeepSeek-V3.2 outputs for the eight context configurations. Each evaluation instance includes the code diff, the reference commit message, the messages generated by the baselines and CAMGen configurations, and access to browsable and searchable repository snapshots from before and after the commit. Three human evaluators with software development experience independently score the messages without knowing their sources. For each method or configuration, we first average the final individual ratings of the three evaluators within each commit and then average these scores across the 50 commits.
paragraphs.zh: 在 RQ3 的人类评估中，我们从 RQ2.2 的消融子集中抽取 50 个提交，并复用相应的 DeepSeek-V3.2 输出，用于八种上下文配置。 每个评估实例包括代码差异、参考提交信息、各基线方法与 CAMGen 配置生成的信息，以及可浏览、可搜索的提交前后仓库快照的访问权限。 三位具有软件开发经验的人类评估者在不知道信息来源的情况下独立对信息打分。 对于每种方法或配置，我们先将三位评估者对每个提交的最终个人评分取平均，再将这些分数在 50 个提交上取平均。

paragraphs.en: To comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of CAMGen, we select the following five baselines based on two criteria. First, the approach must provide a publicly available repository containing the implementation and configuration details required for reproduction, enabling us to rerun it under a unified experimental data and evaluation setting. Second, the approach must be widely adopted in recent CMG studies, thereby ensuring a representative and meaningful comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 为了全面评估 CAMGen 的有效性，我们基于以下两条标准选取了五个基线方法。 首先，该方法必须提供公开可用的代码仓库，其中包含复现所需的实现与配置细节，使我们能够在统一的实验数据和评估设置下重新运行它。 其次，该方法必须在近期的 CMG 研究中被广泛采用，从而确保比较具有代表性和意义。

sents.en: To comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of CAMGen, we select the following five baselines based on two criteria.
sents.zh: 为了全面评估 CAMGen 的有效性，我们基于以下两条标准选取了五个基线方法。

sents.en: First, the approach must provide a publicly available repository containing the implementation and configuration details required for reproduction, enabling us to rerun it under a unified experimental data and evaluation setting.
sents.zh: 首先，该方法必须提供公开可用的代码仓库，其中包含复现所需的实现与配置细节，使我们能够在统一的实验数据和评估设置下重新运行它。
