paragraphs.en: NNGen ( Liu et al., 2018 ) . NNGen is a representative early CMG approach that relies on nearest-neighbor retrieval. Given a code diff, it searches a collection of historical commits for the most similar code change and directly uses the corresponding developer-written commit message as the output.
paragraphs.zh: NNGen（Liu et al., 2018）。 NNGen 是一种具有代表性的早期 CMG 方法，它依赖于最近邻检索。 给定一个代码差异（code diff），它会在历史提交集合中搜索最相似的代码变更，并直接使用对应的开发者编写的提交信息作为输出。

sents.en: NNGen ( Liu et al., 2018 ) .
sents.zh: NNGen（Liu et al., 2018）。

sents.en: NNGen is a representative early CMG approach that relies on nearest-neighbor retrieval.
sents.zh: NNGen 是一种具有代表性的早期 CMG 方法，它依赖于最近邻检索。

sents.en: Given a code diff, it searches a collection of historical commits for the most similar code change and directly uses the corresponding developer-written commit message as the output.
sents.zh: 给定一个代码差异（code diff），它会在历史提交集合中搜索最相似的代码变更，并直接使用对应的开发者编写的提交信息作为输出。

paragraphs.en: CoRec ( Wang et al., 2021a ) . CoRec combines retrieval with neural generation. It first retrieves information related to the current diff from historical data and then supplies the retrieved information to the generator. Unlike approaches that directly copy a retrieved message, CoRec generates a new message for the current change, enabling it to accommodate partial mismatches between the retrieved example and the target commit.
paragraphs.zh: CoRec（Wang等人，2021a）。 CoRec 将检索与神经生成相结合。 它首先从历史数据中检索与当前 diff 相关的信息，然后将检索到的信息提供给生成器。 与直接复制检索到的消息的方法不同，CoRec 为当前变更生成一条新消息，使其能够处理检索到的示例与目标 commit 之间的部分不匹配。

sents.en: CoRec ( Wang et al., 2021a ) .
sents.zh: CoRec（Wang等人，2021a）。

sents.en: CoRec combines retrieval with neural generation.
sents.zh: CoRec 将检索与神经生成相结合。

sents.en: It first retrieves information related to the current diff from historical data and then supplies the retrieved information to the generator.
sents.zh: 它首先从历史数据中检索与当前 diff 相关的信息，然后将检索到的信息提供给生成器。

sents.en: Unlike approaches that directly copy a retrieved message, CoRec generates a new message for the current change, enabling it to accommodate partial mismatches between the retrieved example and the target commit.
sents.zh: 与直接复制检索到的消息的方法不同，CoRec 为当前变更生成一条新消息，使其能够处理检索到的示例与目标 commit 之间的部分不匹配。

paragraphs.en: RACE ( Shi et al., 2022 ) . RACE adopts a retrieval-augmented CMG strategy that uses historical code changes and their commit messages as additional generation context. Its central idea is to exploit expressions and change patterns from historical commits instead of relying solely on the local text of the current diff.
paragraphs.zh: RACE（Shi 等，2022）。 RACE 采用一种检索增强的 CMG 策略，将历史代码变更及其提交消息作为额外的生成上下文。 其核心思想是利用历史提交中的表达方式和变更模式，而不是仅仅依赖当前 diff 的局部文本。

sents.en: RACE ( Shi et al., 2022 ) .
sents.zh: RACE（Shi 等，2022）。

sents.en: RACE adopts a retrieval-augmented CMG strategy that uses historical code changes and their commit messages as additional generation context.
sents.zh: RACE 采用一种检索增强的 CMG 策略，将历史代码变更及其提交消息作为额外的生成上下文。

sents.en: Its central idea is to exploit expressions and change patterns from historical commits instead of relying solely on the local text of the current diff.
sents.zh: 其核心思想是利用历史提交中的表达方式和变更模式，而不是仅仅依赖当前 diff 的局部文本。

paragraphs.en: COME ( He et al., 2023 ) . COME represents code changes through modification embeddings and uses these representations to generate or select candidate messages. By encoding each code change into a semantic representation suitable for CMG, COME addresses the limited ability of surface lexical similarity to capture change content.
paragraphs.zh: COME（He 等，2023）。 COME 通过修改嵌入来表示代码变更，并利用这些表示来生成或选择候选提交消息。 通过将每个代码变更编码为适用于提交消息生成的语义表示，COME 解决了表层词汇相似度在捕获变更内容方面的有限能力。

sents.en: COME ( He et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: COME（He 等，2023）。

sents.en: COME represents code changes through modification embeddings and uses these representations to generate or select candidate messages.
sents.zh: COME 通过修改嵌入来表示代码变更，并利用这些表示来生成或选择候选提交消息。

sents.en: By encoding each code change into a semantic representation suitable for CMG, COME addresses the limited ability of surface lexical similarity to capture change content.
sents.zh: 通过将每个代码变更编码为适用于提交消息生成的语义表示，COME 解决了表层词汇相似度在捕获变更内容方面的有限能力。

paragraphs.en: CCT5 ( Lin et al., 2023 ) . CCT5 is a pretrained generation model designed for code changes. It learns correspondences between code edits and natural-language descriptions through pretraining tasks tailored to code changes. Unlike retrieval-based approaches, CCT5 primarily relies on the code-change knowledge acquired during pretraining to generate a commit message from the input diff.
paragraphs.zh: CCT5（Lin et al., 2023）。 CCT5 是一个专为代码变更设计的预训练生成模型。 它通过针对代码变更定制的预训练任务，学习代码编辑与自然语言描述之间的对应关系。 与基于检索的方法不同，CCT5 主要依赖预训练期间获得的代码变更知识，根据输入的 diff 生成提交信息。

sents.en: CCT5 ( Lin et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: CCT5（Lin et al., 2023）。

sents.en: CCT5 is a pretrained generation model designed for code changes.
sents.zh: CCT5 是一个专为代码变更设计的预训练生成模型。

sents.en: It learns correspondences between code edits and natural-language descriptions through pretraining tasks tailored to code changes.
sents.zh: 它通过针对代码变更定制的预训练任务，学习代码编辑与自然语言描述之间的对应关系。

sents.en: Unlike retrieval-based approaches, CCT5 primarily relies on the code-change knowledge acquired during pretraining to generate a commit message from the input diff.
sents.zh: 与基于检索的方法不同，CCT5 主要依赖预训练期间获得的代码变更知识，根据输入的 diff 生成提交信息。

paragraphs.en: To ensure a fair comparison and prevent test-data leakage throughout the CMG experiments, we first exclude the 7,522 commits in the RQ1 evaluation set from the full ApacheCM dataset. All training data required by the baselines are then sampled from the remaining records. We retrain CoRec, RACE, COME, and CCT5 following their public implementations and experimental settings. For NNGen, we reconstruct the historical candidate collection and retrieval index using only the remaining records. The retrieval corpus for the Historical Exemplar View of CAMGen is also constructed exclusively from the remaining records, excluding all 7,522 evaluation commits. For each target commit, retrieval is further restricted to earlier commits from the same repository, as described in Section 3.5 . In each comparison experiment, all baselines and CAMGen share identical language partitions, evaluation samples, reference commit messages, preprocessing procedure, and evaluation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 为了确保整个CMG实验中比较的公平性并防止测试数据泄露，我们首先从完整的ApacheCM数据集中排除RQ1评估集中的7,522个提交。 基线方法所需的所有训练数据随后从剩余记录中采样。 我们按照其公开的实现和实验设置重新训练CoRec、RACE、COME和CCT5。 对于NNGen，我们仅使用剩余记录重建历史候选集合与检索索引。 CAMGen的历史范例视图的检索语料库也仅从剩余记录中构建，排除全部7,522个评估提交。 对于每个目标提交，如第3.5节所述，检索进一步限制为同一仓库中更早的提交。 在每个对比实验中，所有基线方法与CAMGen共享相同的语言划分、评估样本、参考提交信息、预处理流程和评估流程。

sents.en: To ensure a fair comparison and prevent test-data leakage throughout the CMG experiments, we first exclude the 7,522 commits in the RQ1 evaluation set from the full ApacheCM dataset.
sents.zh: 为了确保整个CMG实验中比较的公平性并防止测试数据泄露，我们首先从完整的ApacheCM数据集中排除RQ1评估集中的7,522个提交。

sents.en: All training data required by the baselines are then sampled from the remaining records.
sents.zh: 基线方法所需的所有训练数据随后从剩余记录中采样。

sents.en: We retrain CoRec, RACE, COME, and CCT5 following their public implementations and experimental settings.
sents.zh: 我们按照其公开的实现和实验设置重新训练CoRec、RACE、COME和CCT5。

sents.en: For NNGen, we reconstruct the historical candidate collection and retrieval index using only the remaining records.
sents.zh: 对于NNGen，我们仅使用剩余记录重建历史候选集合与检索索引。

sents.en: The retrieval corpus for the Historical Exemplar View of CAMGen is also constructed exclusively from the remaining records, excluding all 7,522 evaluation commits.
sents.zh: CAMGen的历史范例视图的检索语料库也仅从剩余记录中构建，排除全部7,522个评估提交。

sents.en: For each target commit, retrieval is further restricted to earlier commits from the same repository, as described in Section 3.5 .
sents.zh: 对于每个目标提交，如第3.5节所述，检索进一步限制为同一仓库中更早的提交。

sents.en: In each comparison experiment, all baselines and CAMGen share identical language partitions, evaluation samples, reference commit messages, preprocessing procedure, and evaluation pipeline.
sents.zh: 在每个对比实验中，所有基线方法与CAMGen共享相同的语言划分、评估样本、参考提交信息、预处理流程和评估流程。

paragraphs.en: This paper employs both automatic evaluation and human evaluation to assess the quality of LLM-generated commit messages. Automatic metrics are used to measure lexical, sequential, and semantic similarity between generated commit messages and reference commit messages, whereas human evaluation assesses content coverage, change rationale, change impact, and linguistic quality of generated commit messages from the developers’ perspective.
paragraphs.zh: 本文同时采用自动评估和人工评估来评价大语言模型生成的提交信息的质量。 自动指标用于衡量生成的提交信息与参考提交信息之间的词汇、序列和语义相似性，而人工评估则从开发者的视角评估生成的提交信息的内容覆盖度、变更理由、变更影响和语言质量。

sents.en: This paper employs both automatic evaluation and human evaluation to assess the quality of LLM-generated commit messages.
sents.zh: 本文同时采用自动评估和人工评估来评价大语言模型生成的提交信息的质量。

sents.en: Automatic metrics are used to measure lexical, sequential, and semantic similarity between generated commit messages and reference commit messages, whereas human evaluation assesses content coverage, change rationale, change impact, and linguistic quality of generated commit messages from the developers’ perspective.
sents.zh: 自动指标用于衡量生成的提交信息与参考提交信息之间的词汇、序列和语义相似性，而人工评估则从开发者的视角评估生成的提交信息的内容覆盖度、变更理由、变更影响和语言质量。

paragraphs.en: Following prior research on CMG ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) , we employ five reference-based automatic evaluation metrics to quantify the similarity between LLM-generated commit messages and reference commit messages. Higher values indicate better generation performance.
paragraphs.zh: 参照以往关于 CMG 的研究（Wu et al., 2025；Zeng et al., 2026），我们采用五种基于参考的自动评估指标来量化大语言模型生成的提交信息与参考提交信息之间的相似度。 数值越高表示生成性能越好。

sents.en: Following prior research on CMG ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) , we employ five reference-based automatic evaluation metrics to quantify the similarity between LLM-generated commit messages and reference commit messages.
sents.zh: 参照以往关于 CMG 的研究（Wu et al., 2025；Zeng et al., 2026），我们采用五种基于参考的自动评估指标来量化大语言模型生成的提交信息与参考提交信息之间的相似度。

sents.en: Higher values indicate better generation performance.
sents.zh: 数值越高表示生成性能越好。

paragraphs.en: BLEU ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) : Originally developed for machine translation evaluation, this metric computes n-gram precision between generated text and a reference. In CMG, it reflects the extent to which a generated message reproduces key phrases and technical expressions from the reference commit message.
paragraphs.zh: BLEU（Papineni et al., 2002）：该指标最初为机器翻译评估而开发，用于计算生成文本与参考文本之间的n元组精确率。 在CMG中，它反映生成的提交信息在多大程度上复现了参考提交信息中的关键短语和技术表达。

sents.en: BLEU ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) : Originally developed for machine translation evaluation, this metric computes n-gram precision between generated text and a reference.
sents.zh: BLEU（Papineni et al., 2002）：该指标最初为机器翻译评估而开发，用于计算生成文本与参考文本之间的n元组精确率。

sents.en: In CMG, it reflects the extent to which a generated message reproduces key phrases and technical expressions from the reference commit message.
sents.zh: 在CMG中，它反映生成的提交信息在多大程度上复现了参考提交信息中的关键短语和技术表达。

paragraphs.en: ROUGE-L ( Lin, 2004 ) : Based on the longest common subsequence between the generated and reference texts, this metric captures overlap in word order and sequential expression, thereby retaining more information about sentence structure than metrics based solely on independent n-grams.
paragraphs.zh: ROUGE-L（Lin，2004）：该指标基于生成文本与参考文本之间的最长公共子序列，能够捕捉词序和顺序表达上的重合，因此相比仅基于独立 n-gram 的指标，能保留更多的句子结构信息。

paragraphs.en: METEOR ( Banerjee and Lavie, 2005 ) : This metric computes the harmonic mean of unigram precision and recall and supports matches based on morphological variants and synonyms. Therefore, it evaluates whether the generated message conveys the primary meaning of the reference under a broader notion of lexical correspondence.
paragraphs.zh: METEOR（Banerjee and Lavie, 2005）：该指标计算一元词精确率和召回率的调和平均值，并支持基于形态变体和同义词的匹配。 因此，它在更宽泛的词汇对应概念下评估生成的消息是否传达了参考消息的主要含义。

sents.en: METEOR ( Banerjee and Lavie, 2005 ) : This metric computes the harmonic mean of unigram precision and recall and supports matches based on morphological variants and synonyms.
sents.zh: METEOR（Banerjee and Lavie, 2005）：该指标计算一元词精确率和召回率的调和平均值，并支持基于形态变体和同义词的匹配。

sents.en: Therefore, it evaluates whether the generated message conveys the primary meaning of the reference under a broader notion of lexical correspondence.
sents.zh: 因此，它在更宽泛的词汇对应概念下评估生成的消息是否传达了参考消息的主要含义。

paragraphs.en: CIDEr ( Vedantam et al., 2015 ) : This metric uses TF-IDF to weight n-grams, emphasizing words and phrases that are distinctive within the corpus. For commit messages that contain API names, module names, and project-specific terminologies, it complements BLEU by emphasizing matches that involve informative phrases.
paragraphs.zh: CIDEr (Vedantam et al., 2015)：该指标使用 TF-IDF 对 n-gram 加权，强调语料库中具有区分度的词和短语。 对于包含 API 名称、模块名称和项目特定术语的提交信息，该指标通过强调涉及信息性短语的匹配来补充 BLEU。

sents.en: CIDEr ( Vedantam et al., 2015 ) : This metric uses TF-IDF to weight n-grams, emphasizing words and phrases that are distinctive within the corpus.
sents.zh: CIDEr (Vedantam et al., 2015)：该指标使用 TF-IDF 对 n-gram 加权，强调语料库中具有区分度的词和短语。

sents.en: For commit messages that contain API names, module names, and project-specific terminologies, it complements BLEU by emphasizing matches that involve informative phrases.
sents.zh: 对于包含 API 名称、模块名称和项目特定术语的提交信息，该指标通过强调涉及信息性短语的匹配来补充 BLEU。

paragraphs.en: SBERT Cosine ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) : This metric uses Sentence-BERT to encode the generated commit messages and the reference commit messages as semantic vectors and computes their cosine similarity. Rather than requiring identical surface wording, SBERT Cosine is used to measure proximity in a sentence-level semantic space.
paragraphs.zh: SBERT 余弦相似度（Reimers and Gurevych, 2019）：该指标使用 Sentence-BERT 将生成的提交信息和参考提交信息编码为语义向量，并计算它们的余弦相似度。 SBERT 余弦相似度并非要求措辞完全一致，而是用于衡量句子级语义空间中的接近程度。

sents.en: SBERT Cosine ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) : This metric uses Sentence-BERT to encode the generated commit messages and the reference commit messages as semantic vectors and computes their cosine similarity.
sents.zh: SBERT 余弦相似度（Reimers and Gurevych, 2019）：该指标使用 Sentence-BERT 将生成的提交信息和参考提交信息编码为语义向量，并计算它们的余弦相似度。

sents.en: Rather than requiring identical surface wording, SBERT Cosine is used to measure proximity in a sentence-level semantic space.
sents.zh: SBERT 余弦相似度并非要求措辞完全一致，而是用于衡量句子级语义空间中的接近程度。

paragraphs.en: This subsection first describes the human evaluation process and then defines the five evaluation dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 本小节首先介绍人类评估流程，然后定义五个评估维度。

paragraphs.en: Human Evaluation Process. To address RQ3, a human evaluation is conducted on the 50-commit evaluation set described in Section 4.2 . For each commit, all three human evaluators receive the code diff, the reference commit message, and the candidate messages generated by the five baselines (see Section 4.3 ), the diff-only baseline, and various view-derived context combinations of CAMGen. They also have access to repository snapshots from before and after the commit, which they can browse and search to inspect surrounding code and compare the two repository states when assessing change content, rationale, and impact. To ensure a blind evaluation, we randomly shuffle the candidate messages and remove all source-identifying information, including model names, method names, and context-configuration identifiers, to prevent bias.
paragraphs.zh: 人工评估流程。 为回答RQ3，我们在4.2节所述的50个提交的评估集上进行了人工评估。 对于每个提交，三位人类评估者都会收到代码差异（code diff）、参考提交信息，以及由五个基线方法（见4.3节）、仅差异（diff-only）基线方法和CAMGen的各种视图派生上下文组合所生成的候选提交信息。 他们还可以访问该提交前后的仓库快照，可以浏览和搜索这些快照以查看周边代码，并在评估变更内容、变更理由和变更影响时对比两个仓库状态。 为确保评估的盲测性，我们随机打乱候选提交信息的顺序，并移除所有能够识别来源的信息，包括模型名称、方法名称和上下文配置标识符，以防止偏差。

sents.en: Human Evaluation Process.
sents.zh: 人工评估流程。

sents.en: To address RQ3, a human evaluation is conducted on the 50-commit evaluation set described in Section 4.2 .
sents.zh: 为回答RQ3，我们在4.2节所述的50个提交的评估集上进行了人工评估。

sents.en: For each commit, all three human evaluators receive the code diff, the reference commit message, and the candidate messages generated by the five baselines (see Section 4.3 ), the diff-only baseline, and various view-derived context combinations of CAMGen.
sents.zh: 对于每个提交，三位人类评估者都会收到代码差异（code diff）、参考提交信息，以及由五个基线方法（见4.3节）、仅差异（diff-only）基线方法和CAMGen的各种视图派生上下文组合所生成的候选提交信息。

sents.en: They also have access to repository snapshots from before and after the commit, which they can browse and search to inspect surrounding code and compare the two repository states when assessing change content, rationale, and impact.
sents.zh: 他们还可以访问该提交前后的仓库快照，可以浏览和搜索这些快照以查看周边代码，并在评估变更内容、变更理由和变更影响时对比两个仓库状态。

sents.en: To ensure a blind evaluation, we randomly shuffle the candidate messages and remove all source-identifying information, including model names, method names, and context-configuration identifiers, to prevent bias.
sents.zh: 为确保评估的盲测性，我们随机打乱候选提交信息的顺序，并移除所有能够识别来源的信息，包括模型名称、方法名称和上下文配置标识符，以防止偏差。

paragraphs.en: We review substantial rating disagreements through discussion and retain a separate final rating from each evaluator. All reported statistics use these post-discussion ratings. For each method or configuration, we average the three evaluator ratings within each commit and then average across the 50 commits. Following prior CMG evaluation research ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , we report the mean of the three pairwise Spearman correlations ( Spearman, 1904 ) for each metric to assess agreement in message rankings. We also report 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals for paired configuration differences and contrasts between view-removal losses. These comparisons are computed within each commit and bootstrapped using 50,000 paired resamples of the 50 commits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过讨论审查了大量评分分歧，并保留每位评估者各自独立的最终评分。 所有报告的统计数据均使用这些讨论后的评分。 对于每种方法或配置，我们先在每个提交内对三位评估者的评分取平均值，然后再在 50 个提交上进行平均。 遵循先前 CMG 评估研究（Zeng et al., 2026）的做法，我们报告每个指标的三组两两 Spearman 相关性（Spearman, 1904）的均值，以评估提交信息排序的一致性。 我们还报告配对配置差异以及移除视图损失之间对比的 95% 百分位自助法置信区间。 这些比较在每个提交内计算，并通过对这 50 个提交进行 50,000 次配对重抽样来自助法估计。

sents.en: We review substantial rating disagreements through discussion and retain a separate final rating from each evaluator.
sents.zh: 我们通过讨论审查了大量评分分歧，并保留每位评估者各自独立的最终评分。

sents.en: All reported statistics use these post-discussion ratings.
sents.zh: 所有报告的统计数据均使用这些讨论后的评分。

sents.en: For each method or configuration, we average the three evaluator ratings within each commit and then average across the 50 commits.
sents.zh: 对于每种方法或配置，我们先在每个提交内对三位评估者的评分取平均值，然后再在 50 个提交上进行平均。

sents.en: Following prior CMG evaluation research ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , we report the mean of the three pairwise Spearman correlations ( Spearman, 1904 ) for each metric to assess agreement in message rankings.
sents.zh: 遵循先前 CMG 评估研究（Zeng et al., 2026）的做法，我们报告每个指标的三组两两 Spearman 相关性（Spearman, 1904）的均值，以评估提交信息排序的一致性。

sents.en: We also report 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals for paired configuration differences and contrasts between view-removal losses.
sents.zh: 我们还报告配对配置差异以及移除视图损失之间对比的 95% 百分位自助法置信区间。

sents.en: These comparisons are computed within each commit and bootstrapped using 50,000 paired resamples of the 50 commits.
sents.zh: 这些比较在每个提交内计算，并通过对这 50 个提交进行 50,000 次配对重抽样来自助法估计。

paragraphs.en: Human Evaluation Metrics. The human evaluation adopts a 0-4 scale, with higher scores indicating better quality. We adopt four dimensions, i.e., Rationality , Comprehensiveness , Conciseness , and Expressiveness ( Li et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026b ) from prior CMG studies. Additionally, we introduce the fifth dimension, Change Impact Explanation , to reflect the focus of this study by assessing whether a commit message explains how a change affects system functionality, program behavior, or module responsibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 人工评估指标。 人工评估采用0-4分制，分数越高表示质量越好。 我们采用以往CMG研究中的四个维度，即合理性、全面性、简洁性和表现力（Li et al., 2024; Li et al., 2026b）。 此外，我们引入第五个维度——变更影响解释，通过评估提交信息是否解释了变更如何影响系统功能、程序行为或模块职责，以体现本研究的关注重点。

sents.en: Human Evaluation Metrics.
sents.zh: 人工评估指标。

sents.en: The human evaluation adopts a 0-4 scale, with higher scores indicating better quality.
sents.zh: 人工评估采用0-4分制，分数越高表示质量越好。

sents.en: We adopt four dimensions, i.e., Rationality , Comprehensiveness , Conciseness , and Expressiveness ( Li et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026b ) from prior CMG studies.
sents.zh: 我们采用以往CMG研究中的四个维度，即合理性、全面性、简洁性和表现力（Li et al., 2024; Li et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: Additionally, we introduce the fifth dimension, Change Impact Explanation , to reflect the focus of this study by assessing whether a commit message explains how a change affects system functionality, program behavior, or module responsibilities.
sents.zh: 此外，我们引入第五个维度——变更影响解释，通过评估提交信息是否解释了变更如何影响系统功能、程序行为或模块职责，以体现本研究的关注重点。

paragraphs.en: Comprehensiveness : This metric assesses whether a commit message accurately and sufficiently summarizes the primary change, including the key change targets, change actions, and affected scope.
paragraphs.zh: 全面性：该指标评估提交信息是否准确且充分地概括了主要变更，包括关键的变更对象、变更操作和影响范围。

paragraphs.en: Rationality : This metric evaluates whether a commit message presents a logically coherent rationale, motivation, or intended objective that is consistent with the code change and thus explains why the change is made. We do not require a specific commit-type format because projects do not uniformly adopt the Conventional Commits specification.
paragraphs.zh: 合理性：该指标评估提交信息是否给出了逻辑连贯的理由、动机或预期目标，且与代码变更相一致，从而说明为什么要进行该变更。 我们不要求特定的提交类型格式，因为各项目并未统一采用约定式提交（Conventional Commits）规范。

sents.en: Rationality : This metric evaluates whether a commit message presents a logically coherent rationale, motivation, or intended objective that is consistent with the code change and thus explains why the change is made.
sents.zh: 合理性：该指标评估提交信息是否给出了逻辑连贯的理由、动机或预期目标，且与代码变更相一致，从而说明为什么要进行该变更。

sents.en: We do not require a specific commit-type format because projects do not uniformly adopt the Conventional Commits specification.
sents.zh: 我们不要求特定的提交类型格式，因为各项目并未统一采用约定式提交（Conventional Commits）规范。

paragraphs.en: Change Impact Explanation : This metric assesses whether a commit message explains how the change affects system functionality, program behavior, module responsibilities, user-visible capabilities, or maintenance activities. It evaluates whether the message transcends local edit operations to provide an accurate explanation of the change’s impact, grounded in both the code and repository context.
paragraphs.zh: 变更影响解释：该指标评估提交信息是否解释了此次变更如何影响系统功能、程序行为、模块职责、用户可见能力或维护活动。 它评估提交信息是否超越了局部的编辑操作，基于代码和仓库上下文，对变更的影响提供准确的解释。

sents.en: Change Impact Explanation : This metric assesses whether a commit message explains how the change affects system functionality, program behavior, module responsibilities, user-visible capabilities, or maintenance activities.
sents.zh: 变更影响解释：该指标评估提交信息是否解释了此次变更如何影响系统功能、程序行为、模块职责、用户可见能力或维护活动。

sents.en: It evaluates whether the message transcends local edit operations to provide an accurate explanation of the change’s impact, grounded in both the code and repository context.
sents.zh: 它评估提交信息是否超越了局部的编辑操作，基于代码和仓库上下文，对变更的影响提供准确的解释。

paragraphs.en: Conciseness : This metric assesses whether a commit message retains the necessary change information while avoiding irrelevant, repetitive, or redundant content. Conciseness does not simply require brevity; it requires a compact description focused on the primary change.
paragraphs.zh: 简洁性：该指标评估提交信息是否在保留必要变更信息的同时，避免了无关、重复或冗余的内容。 简洁性并不只是要求简短，而是要求围绕主要变更进行紧凑的描述。

sents.en: Conciseness : This metric assesses whether a commit message retains the necessary change information while avoiding irrelevant, repetitive, or redundant content.
sents.zh: 简洁性：该指标评估提交信息是否在保留必要变更信息的同时，避免了无关、重复或冗余的内容。

sents.en: Conciseness does not simply require brevity; it requires a compact description focused on the primary change.
sents.zh: 简洁性并不只是要求简短，而是要求围绕主要变更进行紧凑的描述。

paragraphs.en: Expressiveness : This metric evaluates grammatical correctness, fluency, and clarity, with an emphasis on whether readers can understand the message naturally and accurately.
paragraphs.zh: 表达力：该指标评估语法正确性、流畅性和清晰度，重点在于读者能否自然且准确地理解信息。

paragraphs.en: Human and automatic evaluations address complementary aspects: how closely a generated message resembles its reference and whether the message accurately and completely explains the code change.
paragraphs.zh: 人工评估和自动评估解决的是互补的方面：生成的消息与其参考消息的相似程度，以及该消息是否准确且完整地解释了代码变更。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 summarizes the LLMs used in our experiments and their respective tasks. For CMG, we use two open-source models (i.e., DeepSeek-V3.2 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash) and one closed-source model (i.e., GPT-5.4) to evaluate CAMGen across different generation models. For core entity identification in RQ2.1, we compare DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, where DeepSeek-V4-Pro is used exclusively for this task. We set the temperature of all models to 0.0 to reduce generation randomness and keep decoding settings consistent across experiments.

paragraphs.en: RQ1 investigates the overall performance of CAMGen using three different LLMs as generators. We compare five existing approaches on the same dataset for RQ1, evaluating them against the same reference commit messages using five automatic metrics for each programming language. This design enables direct performance comparisons and examines whether the effectiveness of CAMGen varies across programming languages or LLMs. The three DeepSeek/GPT configurations represent CAMGen (Full) where each LLM receives the contexts constructed or retrieved by View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} , View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} , and View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} , rather than only the raw diff.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1 使用三种不同的 LLM 作为生成器来考察 CAMGen 的整体性能。 在 RQ1 中，我们在同一数据集上比较了五种现有方法，针对每种编程语言，使用五项自动指标将它们与相同的参考提交信息进行评估。 这一设计使得性能可以直接比较，并检验 CAMGen 的有效性是否因编程语言或 LLM 的不同而变化。 这三个 DeepSeek/GPT 配置代表 CAMGen（完整版），其中每个 LLM 接收由 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}、View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 和 View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 构建或检索的上下文，而不仅仅是原始 diff。

paragraphs.en: In Java, CAMGen driven by DeepSeek-V4-Flash achieves the best performance across all five metrics, with scores of 13.36 BLEU, 24.42 ROUGE-L, 25.25 METEOR, 11.10 CIDEr, and 55.26 SBERT Cosine. Although CAMGen achieves lower scores with DeepSeek-V3.2 than with the other two LLMs in Java, it still outperforms all five baselines on ROUGE-L, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine, with scores of 22.98, 10.50 and 53.55, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Java 中，由 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 驱动的 CAMGen 在全部五项指标上均取得最佳性能，得分为 13.36 BLEU、24.42 ROUGE-L、25.25 METEOR、11.10 CIDEr 和 55.26 SBERT 余弦相似度。 尽管 CAMGen 在 Java 中使用 DeepSeek-V3.2 时的得分低于另外两个大语言模型，但它在 ROUGE-L、CIDEr 和 SBERT 余弦相似度上仍优于全部五个基线，得分分别为 22.98、10.50 和 53.55。

sents.zh: 在 Java 中，由 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 驱动的 CAMGen 在全部五项指标上均取得最佳性能，得分为 13.36 BLEU、24.42 ROUGE-L、25.25 METEOR、11.10 CIDEr 和 55.26 SBERT 余弦相似度。

sents.en: Although CAMGen achieves lower scores with DeepSeek-V3.2 than with the other two LLMs in Java, it still outperforms all five baselines on ROUGE-L, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine, with scores of 22.98, 10.50 and 53.55, respectively.
sents.zh: 尽管 CAMGen 在 Java 中使用 DeepSeek-V3.2 时的得分低于另外两个大语言模型，但它在 ROUGE-L、CIDEr 和 SBERT 余弦相似度上仍优于全部五个基线，得分分别为 22.98、10.50 和 53.55。

paragraphs.en: On C++, similarly, CAMGen driven by DeepSeek-V4-Flash again leads on all five metrics, with scores of 12.35 BLEU, 26.59 ROUGE-L, 25.13 METEOR, 10.60 CIDEr, and 57.34 SBERT Cosine. Compared to CCT5, which is the strongest baseline on C++ across all five metrics, CAMGen demonstrates absolute gains of 0.14, 2.68, 2.58, 1.78, and 6.85 points, respectively. Meanwhile, CAMGen with DeepSeek-V3.2 also outperforms CCT5 on ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine, while CAMGen with GPT-5.4 outperforms it on ROUGE-L, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine.
paragraphs.zh: 在 C++ 上，类似地，由 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 驱动的 CAMGen 同样在全部五项指标上领先，得分分别为 12.35 BLEU、26.59 ROUGE-L、25.13 METEOR、10.60 CIDEr 和 57.34 SBERT 余弦相似度。 相比于在 C++ 上全部五项指标中都是最强基线的 CCT5，CAMGen 分别取得了 0.14、2.68、2.58、1.78 和 6.85 分的绝对提升。 同时，使用 DeepSeek-V3.2 的 CAMGen 在 ROUGE-L、METEOR、CIDEr 和 SBERT 余弦相似度上也优于 CCT5，而使用 GPT-5.4 的 CAMGen 在 ROUGE-L、CIDEr 和 SBERT 余弦相似度上优于 CCT5。

paragraphs.en: On Python, the best performance of CAMGen is achieved by the two DeepSeek models. More specifically, CAMGen with DeepSeek-V3.2 achieves the highest BLEU, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr scores of 14.01, 28.63 and 11.87, respectively, whereas CAMGen with DeepSeek-V4-Flash leads on METEOR and SBERT Cosine scores of 25.61 and 58.83. Although CAMGen with GPT-5.4 yields lower scores than with the other two LLMs on Python, it still outperforms all five baselines on every metric. These results demonstrate that CAMGen maintains a consistent advantage over the baselines across all three LLM backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Python 上，CAMGen 的最佳性能由两个 DeepSeek 模型取得。 更具体地说，使用 DeepSeek-V3.2 的 CAMGen 取得了最高的 BLEU、ROUGE-L 和 CIDEr 分数，分别为 14.01、28.63 和 11.87，而使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的 CAMGen 在 METEOR 和 SBERT Cosine 分数上领先，分别为 25.61 和 58.83。 尽管在 Python 上使用 GPT-5.4 的 CAMGen 得分低于使用另外两个 LLM 的版本，但它在每项指标上仍优于所有五个基线。 这些结果表明，CAMGen 在所有三个 LLM 骨干上都能保持相对于基线的稳定优势。

paragraphs.en: Compared with CCT5, the strongest baseline across all three languages, CAMGen driven by DeepSeek-V4-Flash improves ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine for Java by 2.31, 3.18, 0.70, and 7.81 points, respectively. The corresponding improvements for C++ are 2.68, 2.58, 1.78, and 6.85 points. For Python, the highest CAMGen score on each metric exceeds CCT5, with the maxima attained by the two DeepSeek generators. The absolute gains include 3.30 BLEU points, 9.62 METEOR points, and 3.24 CIDEr points.
paragraphs.zh: 与 CCT5（三种语言中表现最强的基线）相比，由 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 驱动的 CAMGen 在 Java 上分别将 ROUGE-L、METEOR、CIDEr 和 SBERT Cosine 提升了 2.31、3.18、0.70 和 7.81 分。 C++ 上对应的提升分别为 2.68、2.58、1.78 和 6.85 分。 在 Python 上，CAMGen 在每个指标上的最高得分均超过 CCT5，其中最大值由两个 DeepSeek 生成器取得。 绝对提升包括 3.30 个 BLEU 分、9.62 个 METEOR 分和 3.24 个 CIDEr 分。

sents.en: Compared with CCT5, the strongest baseline across all three languages, CAMGen driven by DeepSeek-V4-Flash improves ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine for Java by 2.31, 3.18, 0.70, and 7.81 points, respectively.

paragraphs.en: CAMGen outperforms the strongest baseline in all three languages. Although CCT5 is the strongest baseline across the three languages, the best CAMGen configuration for each language surpasses it on all five metrics. For Java, CAMGen driven by DeepSeek-V4-Flash yielded gains of 2.31, 3.18, 0.70, and 7.81 points over CCT5 on ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine, respectively. The corresponding gains for C++ are 2.68, 2.58, 1.78, and 6.85 points. For Python, the highest CAMGen score on each metric exceeds CCT5 by 3.30, 5.09, 9.62, 3.24, and 9.75 points for BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine, respectively. These results demonstrate that CAMGen surpasses both existing retrieval-based approaches and the strong code-change-pretrained baseline under a unified data and evaluation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: CAMGen 在全部三种语言上都优于最强的基线方法。 尽管 CCT5 是三种语言中最强的基线，但针对每种语言的最优 CAMGen 配置在全部五项指标上都超过了它。 对于 Java，由 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 驱动的 CAMGen 在 ROUGE-L、METEOR、CIDEr 和 SBERT Cosine 上分别比 CCT5 提升了 2.31、3.18、0.70 和 7.81 分。 对应的 C++ 提升分别为 2.68、2.58、1.78 和 6.85 分。 对于 Python，CAMGen 在每项指标上的最高得分分别超过 CCT5 3.30、5.09、9.62、3.24 和 9.75 分，对应 BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR、CIDEr 和 SBERT Cosine。 这些结果表明，在统一的数据与评估协议下，CAMGen 超越了现有基于检索的方法以及强大的代码变更预训练基线。

For Python, the highest CAMGen score on each metric exceeds CCT5 by 3.30, 5.09, 9.62, 3.24, and 9.75 points for BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine, respectively.

sents.en: These results demonstrate that CAMGen surpasses both existing retrieval-based approaches and the strong code-change-pretrained baseline under a unified data and evaluation protocol.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，在统一的数据与评估协议下，CAMGen 超越了现有基于检索的方法以及强大的代码变更预训练基线。

paragraphs.en: CAMGen substantially improves the semantic quality of commit messages. The gains are particularly pronounced for METEOR and SBERT Cosine. METEOR accounts for recall and supports morphological and synonym matches, whereas SBERT Cosine directly measures sentence-level semantic similarity between the generated commit messages and reference commit messages. For Java, DeepSeek-V4-Flash achieves 25.25 METEOR and 55.26 SBERT Cosine, representing improvements of approximately 14.4% and 16.5% over CCT5, respectively. For C++, the two scores increase from 22.55 and 50.49 to 25.13 and 57.34. For Python, the best scores reach 25.61 and 58.83, corresponding to improvements of approximately 60.2% and 19.9% over CCT5. The consistent gains across languages indicate that multi-view context helps LLMs capture change intent, functional scope, and impact rather than merely reproduce local terms from the reference commit message.

paragraphs.en: CAMGen exhibits strong model adaptability and cross-language generalization across different LLMs and programming languages. CAMGen driven by DeepSeek-V4-Flash achieves the best results on all five metrics for Java and C++, whereas DeepSeek-V3.2 obtains the highest BLEU, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr scores for Python and DeepSeek-V4-Flash obtains the highest METEOR and SBERT Cosine scores. GPT-5.4 also remains competitive across all three languages. The generator therefore influences which model achieves the best result for a particular metric, but the context jointly provided by the three views provides a common semantic input that benefits different models. Moreover, although Java, C++, and Python differ in their type systems, syntax, project organization, and commit-message conventions, the best CAMGen configuration exceeds the strongest baseline for every language, with the highest SBERT Cosine scores reaching 55.26, 57.34, and 58.83, respectively. Within the scope of this evaluation, CAMGen therefore does not depend on a single LLM or the lexical characteristics of one language and demonstrates a context-modeling capability that generalizes across the three CMG language settings.
paragraphs.zh: CAMGen 在不同的 LLM 和编程语言之间展现出强大的模型适应性与跨语言泛化能力。 由 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 驱动的 CAMGen 在 Java 和 C++ 的全部五项指标上取得最佳结果，而在 Python 上，DeepSeek-V3.2 获得最高的 BLEU、ROUGE-L 和 CIDEr 分数，DeepSeek-V4-Flash 获得最高的 METEOR 和 SBERT Cosine 分数。 GPT-5.4 在全部三种语言上也保持了竞争力。 因此，生成器会影响哪个模型在特定指标上取得最佳结果，但由三个视图共同提供的上下文构成了统一的语义输入，使不同的模型都能从中受益。 此外，尽管 Java、C++ 和 Python 在类型系统、语法、项目组织和提交信息约定上各不相同，最佳的 CAMGen 配置在每种语言上都超越了最强的基线，其最高的 SBERT Cosine 分数分别达到 55.26、57.34 和 58.83。 在本次评估范围内，CAMGen 因此并不依赖于某个单一的 LLM 或某种语言的词汇特征，并展现出可泛化到三种 CMG 语言设定的上下文建模能力。

paragraphs.en: The best-performing LLM configuration of CAMGen outperforms the strongest baseline, CCT5, for Java, C++, and Python.
paragraphs.zh: CAMGEN 表现最佳的大语言模型配置在 Java、C++ 和 Python 上超越了最强基线 CCT5。

paragraphs.en: CAMGen substantially improves METEOR and SBERT Cosine, indicating more accurate expression of change intent and functional semantics.

paragraphs.en: RQ2.1 addresses the identification of core entities that serve as the foundation for context construction in CAMGen. Rather than comparing automatic metrics for CMG, this experiment compares model predictions with manually annotated core entities to determine whether the models identify the program entities around which the subsequent contexts should be constructed. Because a commit may modify multiple cooperating entities, we report both entity-level metrics and CmtAccuracy, which requires the complete core-entity set for a commit to be recovered correctly. We randomly sample 100 commits from ApacheCM ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) and manually annotate the core classes, functions, interfaces, and other program entities as the gold labels. DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Pro then identify core entities in the same commits, and we evaluate their predictions using Precision, Recall, F1, Accuracy, and commit-level CmtAccuracy.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2.1 旨在识别核心实体，这些实体是 CAMGen 中上下文构建的基础。 该实验并非比较 CMG 的自动指标，而是将模型预测与人工标注的核心实体进行比较，以确定模型是否识别出后续上下文应围绕其构建的程序实体。 由于一次提交可能修改多个协作的实体，我们同时报告实体级指标和 CmtAccuracy，后者要求提交的完整核心实体集合被正确恢复。 我们从 ApacheCM（Xiong et al., 2025）中随机抽取 100 个提交，并人工标注其中的核心类、函数、接口及其他程序实体作为黄金标签。 然后，DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在相同的提交中识别核心实体，我们使用精确率、召回率、F1、准确率以及提交级的 CmtAccuracy 对它们的预测进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Both LLMs identify core-entity sets accurately. DeepSeek-V4-Flash obtains Precision, Recall, and F1 scores of 0.7862, 0.8013, and 0.7937, whereas DeepSeek-V4-Pro obtains 0.8301, 0.8141, and 0.8220. Recall exceeds 0.80 for both models, showing that both LLMs identify most manually annotated core entities, while their Precision scores indicate that they do not indiscriminately include every entity related to a modification. For CAMGen, this balance between precision and coverage is more important than maximizing either metric in isolation because View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} and View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} use the core entities as shared anchors.

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek-V4-Pro identifies core entities more accurately at both the entity and commit levels. Compared with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Pro increases Precision from 0.7862 to 0.8301 and Recall from 0.8013 to 0.8141. These improvements indicate both a higher proportion of correct predictions among the identified entities and greater coverage of the manually annotated core entities. F1 and Accuracy also increase from 0.7937 to 0.8220 and from 0.7619 to 0.7985, respectively. At the commit level, CmtAccuracy increases from 0.7300 to 0.7700: DeepSeek-V4-Pro predicts core-entity sets that exactly match the manual annotations for 77 of the 100 commits, compared with 73 for DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Compared with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Pro therefore identifies individual core entities more accurately and correctly recovers the full set of core entities for a larger proportion of commits.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在实体级和提交级两个层面都能更准确地识别核心实体。 与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 相比，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 将精确率（Precision）从 0.7862 提升至 0.8301，召回率（Recall）从 0.8013 提升至 0.8141。 这些提升表明，在已识别的实体中正确预测的比例更高，同时对人工标注核心实体的覆盖也更全面。 F1 值与准确率（Accuracy）也分别从 0.7937 提升至 0.8220，从 0.7619 提升至 0.7985。 在提交级上，CmtAccuracy 从 0.7300 提升至 0.7700：在 100 个提交中，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 预测出的核心实体集合与人工标注完全一致的有 77 个，而 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 为 73 个。 因此，与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 相比，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 不仅对单个核心实体的识别更加准确，而且能够为更大比例的提交正确还原完整的核心实体集合。

sents.en: DeepSeek-V4-Pro identifies core entities more accurately at both the entity and commit levels.
sents.zh: DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在实体级和提交级两个层面都能更准确地识别核心实体。

sents.en: Compared with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Pro increases Precision from 0.7862 to 0.8301 and Recall from 0.8013 to 0.8141.
sents.zh: 与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 相比，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 将精确率（Precision）从 0.7862 提升至 0.8301，召回率（Recall）从 0.8013 提升至 0.8141。

sents.en: These improvements indicate both a higher proportion of correct predictions among the identified entities and greater coverage of the manually annotated core entities.
sents.zh: 这些提升表明，在已识别的实体中正确预测的比例更高，同时对人工标注核心实体的覆盖也更全面。

sents.en: F1 and Accuracy also increase from 0.7937 to 0.8220 and from 0.7619 to 0.7985, respectively.
sents.zh: F1 值与准确率（Accuracy）也分别从 0.7937 提升至 0.8220，从 0.7619 提升至 0.7985。

sents.en: At the commit level, CmtAccuracy increases from 0.7300 to 0.7700: DeepSeek-V4-Pro predicts core-entity sets that exactly match the manual annotations for 77 of the 100 commits, compared with 73 for DeepSeek-V4-Flash.
sents.zh: 在提交级上，CmtAccuracy 从 0.7300 提升至 0.7700：在 100 个提交中，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 预测出的核心实体集合与人工标注完全一致的有 77 个，而 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 为 73 个。

sents.en: Compared with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Pro therefore identifies individual core entities more accurately and correctly recovers the full set of core entities for a larger proportion of commits.
sents.zh: 因此，与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 相比，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 不仅对单个核心实体的识别更加准确，而且能够为更大比例的提交正确还原完整的核心实体集合。

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Pro both achieve strong core-entity identification performance against the manually annotated gold labels.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在人工标注的金标准标签上均取得了较强的核心实体识别性能。

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek-V4-Pro outperforms DeepSeek-V4-Flash on all five metrics and retains this advantage at both the entity and commit levels.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在所有五项指标上均优于 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，并且在实体层面和提交层面都保持了这一优势。

paragraphs.en: RQ2.2 decomposes the full CAMGen framework into eight context-input configurations to examine the marginal contribution of the context provided by each view while holding the generator and samples constant. We adopt DeepSeek-V3.2 as the generator because it demonstrates stable cross-language performance in RQ1: it achieves the highest BLEU, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr scores for Python and remains competitive on ROUGE-L and SBERT Cosine for C++. This representative generator retains strong generation capability while controlling for the effect of the model, allowing the ablation results to reflect the effects of the view-derived contexts. The 1,000 commits are randomly sampled from the combined Java, C++, and Python evaluation sets used in RQ1. The analysis examines how the functional-semantic context provided by View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} , the structural-dependency context provided by View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} , and the historical-exemplar context provided by View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} jointly affect generation quality.

Adding the functional-semantic context provided by View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} improves all five metrics, with relative gains of approximately 10.5%, 4.0%, 4.2%, 18.8%, and 0.1% in BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and SBERT Cosine, respectively. paragraphs.en: Incorporating context from individual views consistently improves automatic evaluation metrics over the diff-only baseline, with historical exemplars yielding the strongest single-view performance. Specifically, adding context from ViewStruct, ViewFunc, or ViewExemplar enhances BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, and CIDEr scores. The Structural Dependency View and Functional Semantic View enrich the LLM’s input with repository-level code context surrounding core entities, whereas the Historical Exemplar View supplies paired examples of code diffs and developer-written commit messages. This additional context enables the LLM to generate commit messages that are more semantically accurate and stylistically consistent. Notably, ViewExemplar achieves the highest single-view scores across all five metrics. This advantage likely stems from historical exemplars providing project-specific terminology and writing styles for changes similar to the current code diff, thereby allowing the LLM to produce messages that align more closely with project conventions.
paragraphs.zh: 相比仅使用差异的基线，纳入单个视图的上下文始终能提升自动评估指标，其中历史范例带来了最强的单视图性能。 具体而言，添加来自 ViewStruct、ViewFunc 或 ViewExemplar 的上下文可以提升 BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR 和 CIDEr 分数。 结构依赖视图和功能语义视图通过核心实体周围的仓库级代码上下文来丰富大语言模型的输入，而历史范例视图则提供代码差异与开发者撰写的提交信息的成对示例。 这些额外的上下文使大语言模型能够生成在语义上更准确、风格上更一致的提交信息。 值得注意的是，ViewExemplar 在全部五项指标上都取得了最高的单视图分数。 这一优势可能源于历史范例为与当前代码差异相似的变更提供了项目特定的术语和写作风格，从而使大语言模型能够生成更符合项目约定的提交信息。

sents.zh: 值得注意的是，ViewExemplar 在全部五项指标上都取得了最高的单视图分数。

sents.en: This advantage likely stems from historical exemplars providing project-specific terminology and writing styles for changes similar to the current code diff, thereby allowing the LLM to produce messages that align more closely with project conventions.
sents.zh: 这一优势可能源于历史范例为与当前代码差异相似的变更提供了项目特定的术语和写作风格，从而使大语言模型能够生成更符合项目约定的提交信息。

paragraphs.en: Repository code context further improves semantic alignment when historical exemplars are already available. Adding either View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} or View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} to View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} improves both METEOR and SBERT Cosine. Historical exemplars provide examples of how developers describe similar changes, while repository code supplies context for interpreting the current diff. Specifically, View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} exposes dependencies around the core entities. View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} adds code from candidate functional units containing these entities, helping the LLM examine the responsibilities of the changed code and the implications of the edits. Combining this information with historical examples allows the LLM to describe the current change using project-specific terminology, offering an explanation for the observed gains in semantic alignment with the reference descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 当历史范例已经可用时，仓库代码上下文能进一步提升语义对齐。 在 View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 基础上加入 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} 或 View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 中的任一个，都能同时提升 METEOR 和 SBERT 余弦相似度。 历史范例提供了开发者如何描述相似变更的示例，而仓库代码则为解读当前 diff 提供了上下文。 具体而言，View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} 揭示了核心实体周围的依赖关系。 View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 添加了包含这些实体的候选功能单元中的代码，帮助大语言模型考察被修改代码的职责以及编辑的影响。 将这些信息与历史示例相结合，使大语言模型能够使用项目特定的术语来描述当前变更，从而为观察到的与参考描述在语义对齐上的提升提供了解释。

sents.zh: 将这些信息与历史示例相结合，使大语言模型能够使用项目特定的术语来描述当前变更，从而为观察到的与参考描述在语义对齐上的提升提供了解释。

paragraphs.en: The complete three-view context configuration of CAMGen achieves the best performance across all metrics, and removing any view consistently degrades performance. This indicates that none of the three views is redundant: each contributes complementary information that the LLM relies on to generate more accurate and informative commit messages. View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} and View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} primarily enrich the representation of the code change itself, exposing the structural dependencies and functional semantics around the modified entities. In contrast, View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} complements this information by providing examples of similar diffs and human-written commit messages, which help the LLM align with project-specific terminology and expression styles. Together, the three views enable the LLM to reason about what has changed, why the change matters, and how it should be described, which helps the model generate commit messages that are more accurate, informative, and consistent with project conventions.
paragraphs.zh: CAMGen的完整三视角上下文配置在所有指标上均取得最佳性能，而移除任何视角都会一致地导致性能下降。 这表明三个视角中没有一个是冗余的：每个视角都贡献了互补信息，智能体（LLM）依赖这些信息来生成更准确、更具信息量的提交消息。 View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} 和 View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 主要丰富代码变更本身的表示，揭示被修改实体周围的结构依赖关系和功能语义。 相比之下，View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 通过提供相似差异（diff）及人工编写的提交消息示例来补充这些信息，帮助智能体（LLM）与项目特定的术语和表达风格保持一致。 三个视角结合在一起，使智能体（LLM）能够推断发生了什么变更、该变更为何重要以及应如何描述它，这有助于模型生成更准确、更具信息量且符合项目规范的提交消息。

paragraphs.en: The complete three-view context configuration achieves the best performance among all eight configurations on every auto evaluation metric. Removing any of the three views reduces all five scores, supporting their complementary contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的三视角上下文配置在所有八种配置中，于每项自动评估指标上都取得了最佳性能。 移除三个视角中的任何一个都会降低全部五项分数，这支持了它们的互补性贡献。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 uses human evaluation to assess aspects of generated commit message quality that automatic metrics cannot fully capture. Automatic metrics compare a generated message with the reference commit message, whereas human evaluation further determines whether the message accurately describes the code change target, rationale, and impact. We sample 50 commits from the RQ2.2 ablation subset and provide three human evaluators with the code diffs, reference commit messages, anonymized generated messages, and access to browsable and searchable repository snapshots from before and after each commit. Under the same evaluation protocol, we compare five baselines, the diff-only baseline, and seven view-context combinations. We report mean final ratings across the three evaluators and 50 commits, together with 95% confidence intervals for the comparison between CAMGen(Full) and the diff-only baseline, the three view-removal losses, and the two contrasts between these losses.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 使用人工评估来衡量自动指标无法完全捕捉的生成提交信息质量的各个方面。 自动指标将生成的信息与参考提交信息进行比较，而人工评估则进一步判断该信息是否准确描述了代码变更的目标、理由和影响。 我们从 RQ2.2 消融子集中抽取 50 个提交，向三名人工评估者提供代码差异、参考提交信息、匿名化后的生成信息，以及每个提交前后可浏览、可搜索的代码库快照的访问权限。 在相同的评估协议下，我们比较五个基线、仅差异基线以及七种视图上下文组合。 我们报告三名评估者对 50 个提交给出的最终评分的均值，以及 CAMGen(Full) 与仅差异基线之间、三种视图移除损失之间、以及这两种损失之间两次对比的 95% 置信区间。

paragraphs.en: Among the five existing baselines, CCT5 achieves the highest ratings, with scores of 1.90, 1.01, 1.15, 2.53, and 2.63 on Comprehensiveness, Rationality, Change Impact Explanation, Conciseness, and Expressiveness , respectively. Nevertheless, the diff-only baseline and all seven configurations of CAMGen surpass CCT5 on every dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 在现有的五个基线中，CCT5 获得了最高的评分，其在全面性、合理性、变更影响解释、简洁性和表达性上的得分分别为 1.90、1.01、1.15、2.53 和 2.63。 尽管如此，仅用 diff 的基线以及 CAMGen 的全部七种配置在每个维度上都超过了 CCT5。

paragraphs.en: The diff-only baseline obtains scores of 2.65, 2.30, 2.48, 2.82, and 3.68 on the five dimensions, respectively. Each single-view configuration of CAMGen improves the first four dimensions over this baseline. Among the single-view configurations of CAMGen, View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} achieves the highest Comprehensiveness , Rationality , Change Impact Explanation , and Conciseness scores, reaching 3.05, 2.73, 2.83, and 3.03, respectively. The highest reported Expressiveness score among all configurations is 3.75, shared by View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} alone and View Struct + View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}+\mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} .

paragraphs.en: Among the two-view configurations, View Struct + View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}+\mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} achieves the highest Comprehensiveness score of 3.17, whereas View Func + View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}}+\mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} achieves the highest Rationality , Change Impact Explanation , and Conciseness scores of 2.88, 2.94, and 3.15. Its Expressiveness score is 3.73.
paragraphs.zh: 在双视图配置中，View Struct + View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}}+\mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 取得了最高的全面性得分 3.17，而 View Func + View Exemplar \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}}+\mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 取得了最高的合理性、变更影响解释和简洁性得分，分别为 2.88、2.94 和 3.15。 CAMGen 的完整三视图上下文配置在这四个维度上超过了所有单视图和双视图配置，分别达到 3.34、3.05、3.08 和 3.29。 其表现力得分为 3.73。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 presents the 95% confidence intervals for the paired comparisons. Compared with the diff-only baseline, the complete three-view context configuration of CAMGen improves Comprehensiveness, Rationality, Change Impact Explanation, Conciseness, and Expressiveness by approximately 0.69, 0.75, 0.60, 0.47, and 0.05 points, respectively, with all five confidence intervals lying above zero. For the first four dimensions, the confidence intervals for all three view-removal losses ( Δ Struct \Delta_{\mathrm{Struct}} , Δ Func \Delta_{\mathrm{Func}} , and Δ Exemplar \Delta_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} ) lie above zero. The intervals for Δ Func − Δ Struct \Delta_{\mathrm{Func}}-\Delta_{\mathrm{Struct}} and Δ Func − Δ Exemplar \Delta_{\mathrm{Func}}-\Delta_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} also lie above zero on these four dimensions, showing that removing the functional view causes a larger mean rating loss than removing either the structural view or the historical exemplar view.

Δ Func − Δ Struct \Delta_{\mathrm{Func}}-\Delta_{\mathrm{Struct}} is the rating loss from removing the functional view minus the loss from removing the structural view; Δ Func − Δ Exemplar \Delta_{\mathrm{Func}}-\Delta_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} is the rating loss from removing the functional view minus the loss from removing the historical exemplar view.

paragraphs.en: The complete three-view context configuration of CAMGen achieves the highest human ratings for comprehensiveness, rationality, change impact explanation, and conciseness. Full also receives higher mean ratings than all five existing baselines across every dimension. The observed rating differences indicate that the combined context improves how fully the messages describe the primary change, explain its rationale, and identify its impact while keeping the description focused. This pattern supports the goal of CAMGen: connecting local edits to the functionality they affect so that the generated message conveys the main change and its implications.
paragraphs.zh: CAMGen 的完整三视图上下文配置在全面性、合理性、变更影响解释和简洁性方面获得了最高的人类评分。 Full 在所有维度上的平均评分也都高于现有五种基线方法。 观察到的评分差异表明，组合上下文改善了消息对主要变更的完整描述、对其原因的解释以及对其影响的识别，同时保持了描述的聚焦。 这一模式支持了 CAMGen 的目标：将局部编辑与其影响的功能连接起来，使生成的消息传达主要变更及其影响。

paragraphs.en: Removing the Functional Semantic View causes the largest drops in Comprehensiveness, Rationality, Change Impact Explanation , and Conciseness . The confidence intervals for both contrasts between view-removal losses in Table 7 lie above zero on these dimensions. View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} also achieves the highest single-view ratings on these four dimensions. Together, these results highlight the central role of functional context in CAMGen: by grouping core entities with related entities that jointly implement the affected functionality, the Functional Semantic View connects distributed edits to a common functional objective and provides context for describing their scope and behavioral impact. Notably, while historical exemplars dominate the auto evaluation metrics in RQ2.2, functional context proves most valuable for the human-rated dimensions that assess how well a commit message explains the code change.
paragraphs.zh: 移除功能语义视图导致 Comprehensiveness（全面性）、Rationality（合理性）、Change Impact Explanation（变更影响解释）和 Conciseness（简洁性）下降幅度最大。 表 7 中视图移除损失的两项对比在这些维度上的置信区间均位于零以上。 视图 Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} 在这四个维度上也获得了最高的单视图评分。 这些结果共同凸显了功能上下文在 CAMGen 中的核心作用：通过将核心实体与共同实现受影响功能的相关实体分组，功能语义视图将分散的编辑与共同的功能目标联系起来，并为描述其范围和行为影响提供上下文。 值得注意的是，虽然历史示例在 RQ2.2 的自动评估指标中占主导地位，但功能上下文在人工评分的维度上被证明最有价值，这些维度评估提交信息对代码变更的解释程度。

paragraphs.en: Structural dependencies and historical exemplars each provide complementary gains beyond functional context. The positive confidence intervals for Δ Struct \Delta_{\mathrm{Struct}} and Δ Exemplar \Delta_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} show that removing either view from Full reduces Comprehensiveness , Rationality , Change Impact Explanation , and Conciseness . These improvements reflect the distinct information each view supplies to the LLM: structural context exposes explicit call, inheritance, and instantiation relationships, whereas historical exemplars offer project-specific terminology and writing conventions for describing similar code diffs. By providing the LLM with these complementary sources of information, CAMGen enables the generation of commit messages that offer more complete and focused explanations of change rationale and impact.
paragraphs.zh: 结构依赖和历史范例各自在功能上下文之外提供了互补的收益。 Δ Struct \Delta_{\mathrm{Struct}} 和 Δ Exemplar \Delta_{\mathrm{Exemplar}} 的置信区间为正，表明从 Full 中移除任一视角都会降低 Comprehensiveness、Rationality、Change Impact Explanation 和 Conciseness。 这些改进反映了每个视角向大语言模型提供的独特信息：结构上下文揭示了显式的调用、继承和实例化关系，而历史范例则提供了用于描述类似代码差异的项目特定术语和写作规范。 通过向大语言模型提供这些互补的信息来源，CAMGen 能够生成对变更理由和影响提供更完整、更聚焦解释的提交消息。

paragraphs.en: Richer context helps CAMGen generate more informative and focused commit messages. The concurrent improvements in Conciseness and Comprehensiveness indicate that the additional context enables the LLM to retain essential change information while filtering out irrelevant or repetitive content. Expressiveness , by contrast, varies little across the eight context configurations. Since this metric primarily assesses grammatical correctness, fluency, and clarity, the similar scores across configurations are expected, as all messages are generated by the same underlying LLM. These results suggest that CAMGen primarily enhances the LLM’s understanding of code diffs, enabling it to generate commit messages that more fully describe the main change, explain its rationale and impact, and remain focused on relevant information.
paragraphs.zh: 更丰富的上下文有助于 CAMGen 生成更具信息量和更聚焦的提交消息。 简洁性和全面性的同步提升表明，额外的上下文使大语言模型能够保留关键的变更信息，同时过滤掉无关或重复的内容。 相比之下，表现力在八种上下文配置之间的变化很小。 由于该指标主要评估语法正确性、流畅性和清晰度，各配置下得分相近是符合预期的，因为所有消息都由同一个底层大语言模型生成。 这些结果表明，CAMGen 主要增强了大语言模型对代码差异的理解，使其能够生成更充分地描述主要变更、解释其原理与影响、并始终聚焦于相关信息的提交消息。

paragraphs.en: The complete three-view context configuration achieves the highest mean human ratings for Comprehensiveness , Rationality , Change Impact Explanation , and Conciseness , with gains over the diff-only baseline supported by confidence intervals above zero on all four dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的三视图上下文配置在全面性、合理性、变更影响解释和简洁性方面获得了最高的平均人类评分，其在所有四个维度上相对于仅差异基线的增益均得到了高于零的置信区间的支持。

Its removal from the full configuration also leads to the largest mean rating drops, a conclusion further supported by the fact that the confidence intervals for both contrasts between view-removal losses lie above zero.

paragraphs.en: Structural dependencies and historical exemplars provide further improvements on all four dimensions when added to configurations containing functional context, supporting more complete and focused explanations of code changes.
paragraphs.zh: 在包含功能上下文的配置基础上，加入结构依赖与历史示例后，四个维度上均能获得进一步提升，从而支持对代码变更进行更完整、更聚焦的解释。

paragraphs.en: In this RQ, we aim to further understand the causes of cases in which CAMGen-generated commit messages receive low scores on automatic metrics. We manually inspect the underperforming cases from RQ1 by examining the code diff, the reference commit message, the context constructed or retrieved by CAMGen, and the generated message. The analysis identifies three main categories of causes: Core-Entity Misidentification , Assessment Mismatch , and Incorrect Generation . Assessment Mismatch further includes two subcategories: Low-quality Reference and Semantically Similar Messages . We discuss these categories of causes and representative cases below.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究问题中，我们旨在进一步理解 CAMGen 生成的提交信息在自动指标上得分较低的原因。 我们通过检查代码差异、参考提交信息、由 CAMGen 构建或检索的上下文以及生成的信息，人工分析 RQ1 中表现不佳的案例。 该分析识别出三类主要原因：核心实体识别错误、评估不匹配和错误生成。 评估不匹配进一步包括两个子类别：低质量参考和语义相似的信息。 我们在下面讨论这些原因类别及代表性案例。

sents.en: In this RQ, we aim to further understand the causes of cases in which CAMGen-generated commit messages receive low scores on automatic metrics.
sents.zh: 在本研究问题中，我们旨在进一步理解 CAMGen 生成的提交信息在自动指标上得分较低的原因。

sents.en: We manually inspect the underperforming cases from RQ1 by examining the code diff, the reference commit message, the context constructed or retrieved by CAMGen, and the generated message.
sents.zh: 我们通过检查代码差异、参考提交信息、由 CAMGen 构建或检索的上下文以及生成的信息，人工分析 RQ1 中表现不佳的案例。

sents.en: The analysis identifies three main categories of causes: Core-Entity Misidentification , Assessment Mismatch , and Incorrect Generation .
sents.zh: 该分析识别出三类主要原因：核心实体识别错误、评估不匹配和错误生成。

sents.en: Assessment Mismatch further includes two subcategories: Low-quality Reference and Semantically Similar Messages .
sents.zh: 评估不匹配进一步包括两个子类别：低质量参考和语义相似的信息。

sents.en: We discuss these categories of causes and representative cases below.
sents.zh: 我们在下面讨论这些原因类别及代表性案例。

paragraphs.en: This category refers to cases in which CAMGen identifies entities that do not represent the primary intent of the commit while failing to identify the entity that carries the central change semantics. Because the identified entities serve as anchors for subsequent context construction, an incorrect anchor can affect the structural and functional context supplied to the generator and lead to an inaccurate commit message.
paragraphs.zh: 此类别指这样的情况：CAMGen 识别出的实体并不代表提交的主要意图，同时未能识别出承载核心变更语义的实体。 由于识别出的实体充当后续上下文构建的锚点，错误的锚点会影响提供给生成器的结构和功能上下文，并导致不准确的提交信息。

sents.en: This category refers to cases in which CAMGen identifies entities that do not represent the primary intent of the commit while failing to identify the entity that carries the central change semantics.
sents.zh: 此类别指这样的情况：CAMGen 识别出的实体并不代表提交的主要意图，同时未能识别出承载核心变更语义的实体。

sents.en: Because the identified entities serve as anchors for subsequent context construction, an incorrect anchor can affect the structural and functional context supplied to the generator and lead to an inaccurate commit message.
sents.zh: 由于识别出的实体充当后续上下文构建的锚点，错误的锚点会影响提供给生成器的结构和功能上下文，并导致不准确的提交信息。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 3 , the primary purpose of the Airflow commit 2 2 2 https://github.com/apache/airflow/commit/a19a9cb52388118e5fc735a25cc42229576482ad is to remove the use of deprecated pod-naming functions in the Kubernetes pod operator. However, CAMGen anchors on a helper function whose internal call is modified as a secondary consequence of the migration, while failing to identify the main change in operators/pod.py . As a result, the generated messages focus on renaming helper functions and omit the removal of deprecated naming usage in the pod operator. This example shows how an incorrect core-entity anchor can propagate to subsequent context construction and cause the generated message to miss the primary functional intent of the commit.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 3 所示，Airflow 提交 2 2 2 https://github.com/apache/airflow/commit/a19a9cb52388118e5fc735a25cc42229576482ad 的主要目的是移除 Kubernetes pod 操作器中已弃用的 pod 命名函数的使用。 然而，CAMGen 锚定在一个辅助函数上，该函数的内部调用作为迁移的次要后果被修改，却未能识别 operators/pod.py 中的主要变更。 结果，生成的消息聚焦于重命名辅助函数，而遗漏了 pod 操作器中弃用命名用法的移除。 这个例子表明，错误的核心实体锚点会如何传播到后续的上下文构建中，并导致生成的消息遗漏该提交的主要功能意图。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 3 , the primary purpose of the Airflow commit 2 2 2 https://github.com/apache/airflow/commit/a19a9cb52388118e5fc735a25cc42229576482ad is to remove the use of deprecated pod-naming functions in the Kubernetes pod operator.
sents.zh: 如图 3 所示，Airflow 提交 2 2 2 https://github.com/apache/airflow/commit/a19a9cb52388118e5fc735a25cc42229576482ad 的主要目的是移除 Kubernetes pod 操作器中已弃用的 pod 命名函数的使用。

sents.zh: 结果，生成的消息聚焦于重命名辅助函数，而遗漏了 pod 操作器中弃用命名用法的移除。

sents.zh: 这个例子表明，错误的核心实体锚点会如何传播到后续的上下文构建中，并导致生成的消息遗漏该提交的主要功能意图。

paragraphs.en: Unlike the other two categories, Assessment Mismatch does not necessarily indicate an error in message generation. Instead, the generated message may be semantically valid, whereas its low automatic metric score results from a mismatch between the generated message and the reference commit message. We identify two subcategories in this group.
paragraphs.zh: 与另外两类不同，评估不匹配不一定表明消息生成存在错误。 相反，生成的消息可能在语义上是有效的，而其较低的自动指标得分是由于生成的消息与参考提交消息之间的不匹配造成的。 我们在这一组中识别出两个子类别。

sents.en: Unlike the other two categories, Assessment Mismatch does not necessarily indicate an error in message generation.
sents.zh: 与另外两类不同，评估不匹配不一定表明消息生成存在错误。

sents.en: Instead, the generated message may be semantically valid, whereas its low automatic metric score results from a mismatch between the generated message and the reference commit message.
sents.zh: 相反，生成的消息可能在语义上是有效的，而其较低的自动指标得分是由于生成的消息与参考提交消息之间的不匹配造成的。

sents.en: We identify two subcategories in this group.
sents.zh: 我们在这一组中识别出两个子类别。

paragraphs.en: (1) Low-quality Reference. This subcategory refers to cases in which the reference commit message is too general or contains insufficient information about the actual code change. As shown in Figure 4 , the reference commit message “ DROOLS-5431 DMN XStream and JDK11 ’’ 3 3 3 https://github.com/apache/incubator-kie/commit/b2db6fd531aa17074fb57c2e654a376df09ceeaf provides little information about the code diff. In contrast, the generated messages describe the replacement of the trusting XStream configuration and the addition of explicit type permissions. Although these messages provide substantially more information about the code diff, their automatic metric scores remain low because the reference commit message does not contain the corresponding content. This example indicates that low automatic metric scores may reflect the limited descriptive quality of the reference commit message rather than poor generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 低质量参考提交信息。 该子类别指的是参考提交信息过于笼统，或关于实际代码变更的信息不足的情况。 如图 4 所示，参考提交信息 “ DROOLS-5431 DMN XStream and JDK11 ’’ 3 3 3 https://github.com/apache/incubator-kie/commit/b2db6fd531aa17074fb57c2e654a376df09ceeaf 几乎没有提供关于代码差异的信息。 相比之下，生成的信息描述了对信任的 XStream 配置的替换以及显式类型权限的添加。 尽管这些信息提供了关于代码差异的更多实质性内容，但由于参考提交信息中不包含相应内容，其自动指标得分仍然很低。 该示例表明，自动指标得分低可能反映的是参考提交信息描述质量的有限，而非生成质量差。

paragraphs.en: (2) Semantically Similar Messages. This subcategory refers to cases in which the generated message and the reference commit message correctly convey the same change intent but use different words or sentence structures. As shown in Figure 5 , the reference commit message “ Added support for parsing url in libprocess ’’ 4 4 4 https://github.com/apache/mesos/commit/389e0333cb24727a21ec1ec9e30ddf230a1aa489 and the generated message “ feat(http): Add URL parsing method with scheme, host, port, and path extraction ” both describe the addition of URL parsing support. However, the two messages have limited lexical overlap because the generated message uses different terminologies and provides a more detailed description. Consequently, the generated message receives low lexical metric scores despite being semantically consistent with the reference. This example demonstrates that a single reference commit message may not capture all valid ways of describing the same code change. Similar observations are reported in prior CMG evaluation studies ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: (2) 语义相似的消息。 该子类别指的是这样的情况：生成的消息与参考提交消息正确表达了相同的变更意图，但使用了不同的词语或句子结构。 如图 5 所示，参考提交消息“Added support for parsing url in libprocess”444 https://github.com/apache/mesos/commit/389e0333cb24727a21ec1ec9e30ddf230a1aa489 与生成的消息“feat(http): Add URL parsing method with scheme, host, port, and path extraction”都描述了添加 URL 解析支持这一变更。 然而，这两条消息的词汇重合度有限，因为生成的消息使用了不同的术语，并提供了更详细的描述。 因此，尽管生成的消息在语义上与参考消息一致，其词汇指标得分却很低。 这个例子表明，单一的参考提交消息可能无法涵盖描述同一代码变更的所有有效方式。 先前的提交消息生成评估研究也报告了类似的观察结果（Wu et al., 2025；Zeng et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: This category refers to cases in which the LLM generates an incorrect commit message despite relevant evidence in the supplied code diff and repository context. The generated commit message may mischaracterize the defect being fixed or emphasize secondary edits while failing to convey the primary purpose of the commit. These errors suggest difficulties in interpreting change semantics and distinguishing the main change from accompanying modifications. Similar failures are reported by Wu et al. ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , who identified model fallacy as a category of incorrect commit message generation attributed to limitations of the underlying LLM. CAMGen addresses this by providing structural, functional, and historical context to help the LLM better understand the code diff, enabling the LLM to generate more accurate commit messages that correctly capture the primary code change and its functional impact.
paragraphs.zh: 该类别指的是：尽管所提供的代码差异和仓库上下文中包含相关证据，大语言模型仍生成了不正确的提交信息的情况。 生成的提交信息可能错误描述了所修复的缺陷，或强调次要的编辑而未能传达提交的主要目的。 这些错误表明模型在解读变更语义以及区分主要变更与伴随修改方面存在困难。 Wu 等人报告了类似的失败情况。 （Wu et al., 2025），他们将模型谬误确定为不正确提交信息生成的一个类别，其归因于底层大语言模型的局限性。 CAMGen 通过提供结构、功能和历史上下文来帮助大语言模型更好地理解代码差异，使大语言模型能够生成更准确的提交信息，从而正确捕捉主要的代码变更及其功能影响。

paragraphs.en: Following the empirical research guidelines of Wohlin et al. ( Wohlin et al., 2012 ) , we discuss the factors that may affect our findings in terms of internal, external, construct, and conclusion validity. For each threat, we describe its potential effect and the mitigation measures adopted in the experiments or planned for future improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循Wohlin等人的实证研究指南 （Wohlin等人，2012），我们从内部效度、外部效度、构建效度和结论效度四个方面讨论可能影响研究结果的因素。 针对每一项威胁，我们描述其潜在影响以及在实验中采取的或计划在未来改进的缓解措施。

sents.en: Following the empirical research guidelines of Wohlin et al.
sents.zh: 遵循Wohlin等人的实证研究指南

paragraphs.en: Internal validity concerns potential biases or errors introduced by the experimental design and execution.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度涉及由实验设计与执行所引入的潜在偏差或错误。

paragraphs.en: LLM configurations and prompt design may introduce experimental bias. Model versions, prompt templates, and decoding parameters can affect the generated messages. In RQ1, all three LLMs use the same CAMGen input structure and generation requirements, with the temperature fixed at 0.0. In RQ2.2, we adopt DeepSeek-V3.2 as the generator and keep the samples, generation instructions, and evaluation scripts unchanged. We retrain CoRec, RACE, COME, and CCT5 and rebuild the historical candidate collection and retrieval index for NNGen, following their public implementations and experimental settings. All five baselines are evaluated on the same language-specific datasets as CAMGen. Future work will repeat the experiments across multiple model versions and prompt templates to assess robustness to model updates and prompt variations.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）配置与提示词设计可能引入实验偏差。 模型版本、提示词模板和解码参数都可能影响生成的消息。 在 RQ1 中，三个大语言模型均使用相同的 CAMGen 输入结构和生成要求，并将温度固定为 0.0。 在 RQ2.2 中，我们采用 DeepSeek-V3.2 作为生成器，并保持样本、生成指令和评估脚本不变。 我们按照各自的公开实现和实验设置，重新训练了 CoRec、RACE、COME 和 CCT5，并为 NNGEN 重建了历史候选集合和检索索引。 全部五个基线方法都在与 CAMGen 相同的按语言划分的数据集上进行评估。 未来工作将在多个模型版本和提示词模板上重复实验，以评估对模型更新和提示词变化的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Human evaluation may be affected by the number, professional backgrounds, and individual judgments of the evaluators. RQ3 involves three human evaluators with software development experience: two doctoral students in software engineering and one industry expert in software development. Their interpretations of change completeness, rationale, and impact may differ. To mitigate this threat, we provide a unified scoring guide defining the five evaluation dimensions and scoring criteria of a commit message (see Section 4.4.2 ). Before the formal evaluation, evaluators review representative commit messages that illustrate accurate and complete code diff descriptions, descriptions limited to local edits, and unsupported claims about change impact. They then independently score the same pilot samples and discuss disagreements about whether the messages adequately describe the code diff, explain its rationale, and accurately convey its impact. These discussions help align their interpretation of the scoring criteria. During formal evaluation, the three evaluators initially score commit messages independently in random order, with the source of each message concealed. We revisit substantial disagreements through discussion and retain three sets of individual ratings afterward. All reported means, pairwise Spearman correlations, and bootstrap intervals use these final ratings; the correlations therefore describe agreement after discussion. Future evaluations will include more participants from industry and open-source communities to broaden the diversity of professional backgrounds and project experience represented.
paragraphs.zh: 人工评估可能受到评估者数量、专业背景和个人判断的影响。 RQ3 涉及三位具有软件开发经验的人工评估者：两名软件工程专业的博士生和一位软件开发行业的专家。 他们对变更完整性、理由和影响的理解可能存在差异。 为缓解这一威胁，我们提供了统一的评分指南，定义了提交消息的五个评估维度和评分标准（见第 4.4.2 节）。 在正式评估之前，评估者会审阅具有代表性的提交消息，这些消息展示了准确完整的代码差异描述、仅限于局部修改的描述，以及缺乏依据的变更影响断言。 随后，他们独立对相同的试点样本进行评分，并就消息是否充分描述代码差异、解释其理由以及准确传达其影响的分歧进行讨论。 这些讨论有助于统一他们对评分标准的理解。 在正式评估中，三位评估者首先以随机顺序独立对提交消息进行评分，并隐匿每条消息的来源。 我们通过讨论重新审视重大分歧，并保留三份独立的评分结果。 所有报告的均值、两两 Spearman 相关性和自助法区间均基于这些最终评分；因此这些相关性描述的是讨论后的一致程度。 未来的评估将纳入更多来自产业界和开源社区的参与者，以扩大所涵盖的专业背景和项目经验的多样性。

paragraphs.en: External validity concerns the extent to which the findings generalize to other software projects, programming languages, LLMs, and development environments.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度关注的是研究结果能够推广到其他软件项目、编程语言、大语言模型（LLM）和开发环境的程度。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate CAMGen on Java, C++, and Python using two open-source LLMs and one closed-source LLM. These settings allow us to examine its effectiveness across multiple programming languages and models. However, whether the observed improvements generalize to other languages and LLMs requires further evaluation. Future work will extend the evaluation to additional languages, such as JavaScript, Go, and Rust, and include more LLMs with different code understanding and generation capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用两个开源大语言模型和一个闭源大语言模型，在 Java、C++ 和 Python 上评估 CAMGen。 这些设置使我们能够检验其在多种编程语言和多个模型上的有效性。 然而，所观察到的提升能否推广到其他语言和大语言模型，仍需进一步评估。 未来的工作将把评估扩展到更多语言，例如 JavaScript、Go 和 Rust，并纳入更多具有不同代码理解与生成能力的大语言模型。

paragraphs.en: LLMs accessed through vendor APIs may change over time. We invoke DeepSeek-V3.2, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and GPT-5.4 through vendor APIs. Providers may update server-side weights, inference strategies, safety policies, or default parameters while retaining the same model name. Consequently, identical inputs may produce different outputs over time, affecting the reproducibility of the experimental results.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based core-entity identification may still produce errors. CAMGen uses an LLM to identify the core entities that carry the primary change intent and uses them as shared anchors for constructing View Struct \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Struct}} and View Func \mathrm{View}_{\mathrm{Func}} . In RQ2.1, DeepSeek-V4-Pro achieves 0.8301 Precision, 0.8141 Recall, and 0.8220 F1 against the manually annotated gold labels, demonstrating strong core-entity identification performance. However, some commits may still contain missed or incorrectly identified entities, which can affect subsequent context construction. To mitigate this threat, we compare two LLMs and use the better-performing model for core-entity identification. Future work will enlarge the manually annotated dataset, refine the identification prompt, and explore methods for detecting and correcting errors in core-entity identification for code diff.

paragraphs.en: The threats to conclusion validity concern the transparency and reproducibility of the experimental process. In this work, the methodology and experimental design of CAMGen are detailed in Sections 3 and 4 , and a replication package ( Xiong et al., 2026a ) has been provided to support independent reproduction. We also adopt the LLM temperature at 0.0 to reduce generation randomness. However, updates to LLMs accessed through vendor APIs may affect the exact reproducibility of the experiment results, even when the same inputs and configurations are used.

paragraphs.en: This study addresses the limitation that existing CMG methods provide insufficient functional context for understanding the intent and impact of code changes. We propose CAMGen, a core change-aware multi-view framework for CMG. It identifies core entities in the code changes and uses them as anchors to retrieve functional and structural context from the repository, while also retrieving similar diff-message pairs as exemplars. CAMGen then provides the combined context together with the code diff to an LLM to generate commit messages. Experiments demonstrate that CAMGen consistently outperforms representative CMG approaches on automatic metrics. Human evaluation also shows that CAMGen generates more complete messages with clearer change rationale and more informative impact explanations. These results demonstrate the value of function-aware multi-view context for generating accurate, informative, and project-consistent commit messages.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究解决了现有 CMG 方法在理解代码变更的意图和影响时提供的功能性上下文不足这一局限。 我们提出了 CAMGen，一种用于 CMG 的核心变更感知多视图框架。 它识别代码变更中的核心实体，并以它们为锚点从仓库中检索功能性和结构性上下文，同时检索相似的 diff-message 对作为示例。 随后，CAMGen 将组合后的上下文与代码 diff 一起提供给大语言模型（LLM）以生成提交消息。 实验表明，CAMGen 在自动指标上始终优于具有代表性的 CMG 方法。 人工评估还表明，CAMGen 生成的消息更加完整，变更理由更清晰，影响说明更具信息量。 这些结果证明了功能感知的多视图上下文对于生成准确、信息丰富且与项目一致的提交消息的价值。

paragraphs.en: Future work will investigate context selection for different code change types, such as bug fixes, feature additions, and refactorings, to improve the relevance of the context used for CMG. We also plan to explore incremental context updates to reduce the cost of generating messages for successive commits. Incorporating issue reports and code review discussions will provide LLMs with additional evidence about the problems and design decisions behind code changes. We will evaluate whether this evidence helps LLMs generate higher-quality commit messages.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作将研究针对不同代码变更类型（如缺陷修复、功能新增和重构）的上下文选择，以提高用于 CMG 的上下文的相关性。 我们还计划探索增量式上下文更新，以降低为连续提交生成消息的成本。 纳入问题报告和代码评审讨论将为大语言模型提供关于代码变更背后的问题和设计决策的额外证据。 我们将评估这些证据是否有助于大语言模型生成更高质量的提交消息。
